ददौ तस्यै वस्त्रयुग्मं वरुणादाहृतं च यत् ॥
तदाहृतां रत्नमालां त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम् ॥ 134 ॥
2.16.m:
He kissed her firm cheek and, once again, her bimba-fruit lips.
He gave her a pair of garments that had been taken from Varuṇa,
and a jewelled necklace taken from him, renowned throughout the three worlds. // 134

2.16.s:
dadau mañjīrayugmaṃ ca svāhāyāśca hṛtaṃ ca yat ..
keyūrayugmaṃ chāyāyā rohiṇyāścaiva kuṇḍalam .. 135 ..
2.16.d:
ददौ मञ्जीरयुग्मं च स्वाहायाश्च हृतं च यत् ॥
केयूरयुग्मं छायाया रोहिण्याश्चैव कुण्डलम् ॥ 135 ॥
2.16.m:
He gave her a pair of anklets that had been stolen from Svāhā,
a pair of armlets from Chāyā, and earrings from Rohiṇī, // 135

2.16.s:
aṃgulīyakaratnāni ratyāśca varabhūṣaṇam ..
śaṅkhaṃ suruciraṃ citraṃ yaddattaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 136 ..
2.16.d:
अंगुलीयकरत्नानि रत्याश्च वरभूषणम् ॥
शङ्खं सुरुचिरं चित्रं यद्दत्तं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ 136 ॥
2.16.m:
jewelled rings and the excellent ornaments of Rati,
and an exquisite, variegated conch shell given by Viśvakarman. // 136

2.16.s:
vicitrapīṭhakaśreṇīṃ śayyāṃ cāpi sudurlabhām ..
bhūṣaṇāni ca dattvā ca parīhāraṃ cakāra ha .. 137 ..
2.16.d:
विचित्रपीठकश्रेणीं शय्यां चापि सुदुर्लभाम् ॥
भूषणानि च दत्त्वा च परीहारं चकार ह ॥ 137 ॥
2.16.m:
Having also given a series of variegated pedestals, a very rare bed,
and ornaments, he then made jesting conversation. // 137

2.16.s:
nirmāya kabarībhāraṃ tasyāśca mālyasaṃyutam ..
sucitraṃ patrakaṃ gaṇḍe jayalekhasamaṃ tathā .. 138 ..
2.16.d:
निर्माय कबरीभारं तस्याश्च माल्यसंयुतम् ॥
सुचित्रं पत्रकं गण्डे जयलेखसमं तथा ॥ 138 ॥
2.16.m:
Having arranged the mass of her braided hair, bound with garlands,
and painted on her cheek a beautiful design like an inscription of victory, // 138

2.16.s:
candralekhātribhiryuktaṃ candanena sugandhinā ..
paritaḥ paritaścitraiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃkumabindubhiḥ .. 139 ..
2.16.d:
चन्द्रलेखात्रिभिर्युक्तं चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना ॥
परितः परितश्चित्रैः सार्द्धं कुंकुमबिन्दुभिः ॥ 139 ॥
2.16.m:
marked with three crescent lines of fragrant sandalwood,
surrounded all around by variegated dots of saffron, // 139

2.16.s:
jvalatpradīpākāraṃ ca sindūratilakaṃ dadau ..
tatpādapadmayugale sthalapadmavinindite .. 2.16.140 ..
2.16.d:
ज्वलत्प्रदीपाकारं च सिन्दूरतिलकं ददौ ॥
तत्पादपद्मयुगले स्थलपद्मविनिन्दिते ॥ 2.16.140 ॥
2.16.m:
he applied a tilaka of red vermilion shaped like a blazing lamp.
Upon her pair of lotus feet, which surpassed the terrestrial lotus, // 140

2.16.s:
citrālaktakarāgaṃ ca nakhareṣu dadau mudā ..
svavakṣasi muhurnyastaṃ sarāgaṃ caraṇāmbujam .. 141 ..
2.16.d:
चित्रालक्तकरागं च नखरेषु ददौ मुदा ॥
स्ववक्षसि मुहुर्न्यस्तं सरागं चरणाम्बुजम् ॥ 141 ॥
2.16.m:
he joyfully applied variegated red lac dye to the toenails.
Placing again and again her reddened lotus foot upon his chest,

2.16.s:
he devi tava dāso'hamityuccāryya punaḥ punaḥ ..
ratnanirmāṇayānena tāṃ ca kṛtvā svavakṣasi .. 142 ..
2.16.d:
हे देवि तव दासोऽहमित्युच्चार्य्य पुनः पुनः ॥
रत्ननिर्माणयानेन तां च कृत्वा स्ववक्षसि ॥ 142 ॥
2.16.m:
saying repeatedly, “O goddess, I am your servant,” // 141
he placed her on his chest in a vehicle made of jewels. // 142

2.16.s:
tapovanaṃ parityajya rājāsthānāntaraṃ yayau..
malaye devanilaye śaile śaile vane vane .. 143 ..
2.16.d:
तपोवनं परित्यज्य राजास्थानान्तरं ययौ॥
मलये देवनिलये शैले शैले वने वने ॥ 143 ॥
2.16.m:
Leaving the penance forest, the king went to another realm:
on Malaya, the abode of gods, on mountain after mountain, in forest after forest, // 143

2.16.s:
sthāne sthāne'tiramye ca puṣpodyāne'tinirjane ..
kandare kandare sindhutīre ca sundare vane .. 144 ..
2.16.d:
स्थाने स्थानेऽतिरम्ये च पुष्पोद्यानेऽतिनिर्जने ॥
कन्दरे कन्दरे सिन्धुतीरे च सुन्दरे वने ॥ 144 ॥
2.16.m:
in exceedingly lovely place after place, in utterly secluded flower gardens,
in cave after cave, on the seashore, and in the beautiful forest, // 144

2.16.s:
puṣpabhadrānadītīre nīravātamanohare ..
puline puline divye nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade .. 145 ..
2.16.d:
पुष्पभद्रानदीतीरे नीरवातमनोहरे ॥
पुलिने पुलिने दिव्ये नद्यां नद्यां नदे नदे ॥ 145 ॥
2.16.m:
on the bank of the Puṣpabhadrā river, delightful with water and breezes,
on divine sandbank after sandbank, along river after river and stream after stream, // 145

2.16.s:
madhau madhukarāṇāṃ ca madhuradhvaninādite ..
vinisyande supavane nandane gandhamādane .. 146 ..
2.16.d:
मधौ मधुकराणां च मधुरध्वनिनादिते ॥
विनिस्यन्दे सुपवने नन्दने गन्धमादने ॥ 146 ॥
2.16.m:
resounding with the sweet humming of bees in springtime,
in the Vinisyanda forest with gentle breezes, in Nandana, on Mount Gandhamādana, // 146

2.16.s:
devodyāne devavane citre candanakānane ..
campakānāṃ ketakīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ ca mādhave ..147..
2.16.d:
देवोद्याने देववने चित्रे चन्दनकानने ॥
चम्पकानां केतकीनां माधवीनां च माधवे ॥147॥
2.16.m:
in the garden of the gods, in the grove of the gods, in the wondrous sandalwood forest,
in spring, amid groves of campakas, ketakīs, and mādhavīs, // 147

2.16.s:
kundānāṃ mālatīnāṃ ca kumudāmbhojakānane ..
kalpavṛkṣe kalpavṛkṣe pārijātavane vane ..148..
2.16.d:
कुन्दानां मालतीनां च कुमुदाम्भोजकानने ॥
कल्पवृक्षे कल्पवृक्षे पारिजातवने वने ॥148॥
2.16.m:
amid groves of kundas, mālatīs, night-blooming lotuses, and daytime lotuses,
at wishing tree after wishing tree, in grove after grove of pārijāta trees, // 148

2.16.s:
nirjane kāñcanīsthāne dhanye kāñcanaparvate ..
kāñcīvane kiñcanake kañcake kāñcanākare .. 149 ..
2.16.d:
निर्जने काञ्चनीस्थाने धन्ये काञ्चनपर्वते ॥
काञ्चीवने किञ्चनके कञ्चके काञ्चनाकरे ॥ 149 ॥
2.16.m:
in the secluded golden region, on the blessed mountain of gold,
in the Kāñcī forest, on Mount Kiñcanaka, on Kañcaka, and at the mine of gold. // 149

2.16.s:
puṣpacandanatalpe ca puṃskokilarutaśrute ..
puṣpacandanasaṃyuktaḥ puṣpacandanavāyunā .. 2.16.150 ..
2.16.d:
पुष्पचन्दनतल्पे च पुंस्कोकिलरुतश्रुते ॥
पुष्पचन्दनसंयुक्तः पुष्पचन्दनवायुना ॥ 2.16.150 ॥
2.16.m:
On a bed of flowers and sandalwood, where the cries of male cuckoos were heard,
adorned with flowers and sandalwood paste, cooled by breezes laden with flowers and sandalwood, // 150

2.16.s:
kāmukyā kāmukaḥ kāmātsa reme rāmayā saha ..
na tṛpto dānavendraśca tṛptiṃ naiva jagāma sā .. 151 ..
2.16.d:
कामुक्या कामुकः कामात्स रेमे रामया सह ॥
न तृप्तो दानवेन्द्रश्च तृप्तिं नैव जगाम सा ॥ 151 ॥
2.16.m:
the impassioned lover passionately made love with that lovely, passionate woman.
The lord of the Dānavas was not satiated, nor did she attain satiation; // 151

2.16.s:
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva vavṛdhe madanastayoḥ ..
tayā saha samāgatya svāśramaṃ dānavastataḥ .. 152 ..
2.16.d:
हविषा कृष्णवर्त्मेव ववृधे मदनस्तयोः ॥
तया सह समागत्य स्वाश्रमं दानवस्ततः ॥ 152 ॥
2.16.m:
their passion increased like fire fed with clarified butter.
Then, having returned with her to his hermitage, the Dānava, // 152

2.16.s:
ramyaṃ krīḍālayaṃ kṛtvā vijahāra punastataḥ ..
evaṃ saṃbubhuje rājyaṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān .. 153 ..
2.16.d:
रम्यं क्रीडालयं कृत्वा विजहार पुनस्ततः ॥
एवं संबुभुजे राज्यं शङ्खचूडः प्रतापवान् ॥ 153 ॥
2.16.m:
having built a charming pleasure house, sported there once again.
Thus the mighty Śaṅkhacūḍa enjoyed his sovereignty // 153

2.16.s:
ekamanvantaraṃ pūrṇaṃ rājarājeśvaro balī ..
devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ ca santatam .. 154 ..
2.16.d:
एकमन्वन्तरं पूर्णं राजराजेश्वरो बली ॥
देवानामसुराणां च दानवानां च सन्ततम् ॥ 154 ॥
2.16.m:
for a full manvantara as the powerful king of kings,
constantly chastising the gods, the asuras, and the dānavas, // 154

2.16.s:
gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca śāstidaḥ ..
hatādhikārā devāśca caranti bhikṣukā yathā .. 155 ..
2.16.d:
गन्धर्वाणां किन्नराणां राक्षसानां च शास्तिदः ॥
हताधिकारा देवाश्च चरन्ति भिक्षुका यथा ॥ 155 ॥
2.16.m:
the gandharvas, the kinnaras, and the rākṣasas.
Deprived of their authority, the gods wandered about like beggars. // 155

2.16.s:
pūjāhomādikaṃ teṣāṃ jahāra viṣayaṃ balāt ..
āśrayaṃ cādhikāraṃ ca śastrāstrabhūṣaṇādikam .. 196 ..
2.16.d:
पूजाहोमादिकं तेषां जहार विषयं बलात् ॥
आश्रयं चाधिकारं च शस्त्रास्त्रभूषणादिकम् ॥ 196 ॥
2.16.m:
He forcibly seized their domains, their worship, burnt offerings, and the like,
their abode, their authority, their weapons, missiles, ornaments, and more. // 156

2.16.s:
nirudyamāḥ surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ..
te ca sarve viṣaṇṇāśca prajagmurbrahmaṇaḥ sabhām.. .. 157 ..
2.16.d:
निरुद्यमाः सुराः सर्वे चित्रपुत्तलिका यथा ॥
ते च सर्वे विषण्णाश्च प्रजग्मुर्ब्रह्मणः सभाम्॥ ॥ 157 ॥
2.16.m:
All the gods became inactive, like painted puppets;
and, completely despondent, they all went to the assembly hall of Brahmā. // 157

2.16.s:
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsū ruruduśca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ..
tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma śaṅkarālayam .. 158 ..
2.16.d:
वृत्तान्तं कथयामासू रुरुदुश्च भृशं मुहुः ॥
तदा ब्रह्मा सुरैः सार्द्धं जगाम शङ्करालयम् ॥ 158 ॥
2.16.m:
They related the whole account and wept aloud again and again.
Then Brahmā went together with the gods to the abode of Śaṅkara. // 158

2.16.s:
sarvaṃ saṃkathayāmāsa vidhātā candraśekharam ..
brahmā śivaśca taiḥ sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha .. 159 ..
2.16.d:
सर्वं संकथयामास विधाता चन्द्रशेखरम् ॥
ब्रह्मा शिवश्च तैः सार्द्धं वैकुण्ठं च जगाम ह ॥ 159 ॥
2.16.m:
The Creator related everything to the moon-crested god;
and Brahmā and Śiva, along with them, went to Vaikuṇṭha, // 159

2.16.s:
sudurlabhaṃ paraṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ..
samprāpa ca varaṃ dvāramāśramāṇāṃ hareraho .. 2.16.160 ..
2.16.d:
सुदुर्लभं परं धाम जरामृत्युहरं परम् ॥
सम्प्राप च वरं द्वारमाश्रमाणां हरेरहो ॥ 2.16.160 ॥
2.16.m:
the supreme abode, exceedingly difficult to attain, which removes old age and death.
Ah, he arrived at the excellent gateway among the dwellings of Hari! // 160

2.16.s:
dadarśa dvārapālāṃśca ratnasiṃhāsanasthitān ..
śobhitānpītavastraiśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān.. .. 161 ..
2.16.d:
ददर्श द्वारपालांश्च रत्नसिंहासनस्थितान् ॥
शोभितान्पीतवस्त्रैश्च रत्नभूषणभूषितान्॥ ॥ 161 ॥
2.16.m:
He saw the gatekeepers seated on jewelled thrones,
adorned with yellow garments and bedecked with jewelled ornaments, // 161

2.16.s:
vanamālānvitānsarvānśyāmasundaravigrahān ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharāṃścaiva caturbhujān .. 162 ..
2.16.d:
वनमालान्वितान्सर्वान्श्यामसुन्दरविग्रहान् ॥
शंखचक्रगदापद्मधरांश्चैव चतुर्भुजान् ॥ 162 ॥
2.16.m:
all wearing forest garlands, their bodies dark and handsome,
holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, four-armed, // 162

2.16.s:
sasmitānpadmavaktrāṃśca padmanetrānmanoharān ..
brahmā tānkathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ gamanārthakam .. 163 ..
2.16.d:
सस्मितान्पद्मवक्त्रांश्च पद्मनेत्रान्मनोहरान् ॥
ब्रह्मा तान्कथयामास वृत्तान्तं गमनार्थकम् ॥ 163 ॥
2.16.m:
smiling, lotus-faced, lotus-eyed, and captivating.
Brahmā told them the matter concerning the purpose of his coming. // 163

2.16.s:
te'nujñāṃ ca dadustasmai praviveśa tadājñayā ..
evaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa dvārānnirīkṣya kamalodbhavaḥ .. 164 ..
2.16.d:
तेऽनुज्ञां च ददुस्तस्मै प्रविवेश तदाज्ञया ॥
एवं च षोडश द्वारान्निरीक्ष्य कमलोद्भवः ॥ 164 ॥
2.16.m:
They gave him permission, and by their command he entered.
Having thus observed the sixteen gates, the lotus-born [Brahmā],

2.16.s:
devaḥ sārddhaṃ tānatītya praviveśa hareḥ sabhām ..
devarṣibhiḥ parivṛtāṃ pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ .. 165 ..
2.16.d:
देवः सार्द्धं तानतीत्य प्रविवेश हरेः सभाम् ॥
देवर्षिभिः परिवृतां पार्षदैश्च चतुर्भुजैः ॥ 165 ॥
2.16.m:
the god, along with them, passed beyond and entered the assembly-hall of Hari,
surrounded by divine sages and four-armed attendants,

2.16.s:
nārāyaṇasvarūpaiśca sarvaiḥ kaustubhabhūṣitaiḥ ..
pūrṇendumaṇḍalākārāṃ caturasrāṃ manoharām .. 166 ..
2.16.d:
नारायणस्वरूपैश्च सर्वैः कौस्तुभभूषितैः ॥
पूर्णेन्दुमण्डलाकारां चतुरस्रां मनोहराम् ॥ 166 ॥
2.16.m:
bearing the form of Nārāyaṇa and all adorned with the Kaustubha jewel;
shaped like the orb of the full moon, four-sided, captivating,

2.16.s:
maṇīndrasāranirmāṇāṃ hīrāsārasuśobhitām ..
amūlyaratnakhacitāṃ racitāṃ svecchayā hareḥ .. 167 ..
2.16.d:
मणीन्द्रसारनिर्माणां हीरासारसुशोभिताम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नखचितां रचितां स्वेच्छया हरेः ॥ 167 ॥
2.16.m:
constructed from the essence of best gems, brightly adorned with the essence of diamonds,
inlaid with priceless jewels, fashioned by the mere will of Hari,

2.16.s:
māṇikyamālājālāḍhyāṃ muktāpaṃktivibhūṣitām ..
maṇḍitāṃ maṇḍalākārai ratnadarpaṇakoṭibhiḥ..168..
2.16.d:
माणिक्यमालाजालाढ्यां मुक्तापंक्तिविभूषिताम् ॥
मण्डितां मण्डलाकारै रत्नदर्पणकोटिभिः॥168॥
2.16.m:
abounding with networks of ruby garlands, adorned with rows of pearls,
decorated with millions of circular gem mirrors,

2.16.s:
vicitraiścitrarekhābhirnānācitravicitritām..
padmarāgendraracitai racitāṃ padmakṛtrimaiḥ .. ..169..
2.16.d:
विचित्रैश्चित्ररेखाभिर्नानाचित्रविचित्रिताम्॥
पद्मरागेन्द्ररचितै रचितां पद्मकृत्रिमैः ॥ ॥169॥
2.16.m:
diversified with various wonderful lines and pictures,
fashioned with artificial lotuses wrought of prime rubies,

2.16.s:
sopānaśatakairyuktāṃ syamantakavinirmitaiḥ..
paṭṭasūtragranthiyutaiścārucandanapallavaiḥ..2.16.170..
2.16.d:
सोपानशतकैर्युक्तां स्यमन्तकविनिर्मितैः॥
पट्टसूत्रग्रन्थियुतैश्चारुचन्दनपल्लवैः॥2.16.170॥
2.16.m:
fitted with hundreds of stairways made of Syamantaka jewels,
with beautiful sandalwood shoots tied with silk threads,

2.16.s:
indranīlamaṇistambhairveṣṭitāṃ sumanoramām..
sadratnapūrṇakumbhānāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitām .. 171 ..
2.16.d:
इन्द्रनीलमणिस्तम्भैर्वेष्टितां सुमनोरमाम्॥
सद्रत्नपूर्णकुम्भानां समूहैश्च समन्विताम् ॥ 171 ॥
2.16.m:
surrounded by pillars of sapphire, intensely charming,
furnished with collections of pitchers filled with fine jewels,

2.16.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitām ..
kastūrīkuṅkumāktaiśca sugandhicandanadravaiḥ .. 172 ..
2.16.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विराजिताम् ॥
कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमाक्तैश्च सुगन्धिचन्दनद्रवैः ॥ 172 ॥
2.16.m: anointed with musk and saffron and fragrant liquid sandalwood,

2.16.s:
susaṃskṛtāṃ tu sarvatra vāsitā gandhavāyunā ..
vidyādharīsamūhānāṃ saṅgītaiśca manoharam .. 173 ..
2.16.d:
सुसंस्कृतां तु सर्वत्र वासिता गन्धवायुना ॥
विद्याधरीसमूहानां सङ्गीतैश्च मनोहरम् ॥ 173 ॥
2.16.m:
well prepared in every part, scented by fragrant breezes,
captivating with the songs of multitudes of Vidyādharīs,

2.16.s:
sahasrayojanāyāmāṃ paripūrṇāṃ ca kiṃkaraiḥ ..
dadarśa śrīhariṃ brahmā śaṅkaraiśca suraiḥ saha .. 174 ..
vasantaṃ tanmadhyadeśe yathendraṃ tārakāvṛtam ..
amūlyaratnanirmāṇacitrasiṃhāsanasthitam .. 179 ..
2.16.d:
सहस्रयोजनायामां परिपूर्णां च किंकरैः ॥
ददर्श श्रीहरिं ब्रह्मा शङ्करैश्च सुरैः सह ॥ 174 ॥
वसन्तं तन्मध्यदेशे यथेन्द्रं तारकावृतम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणचित्रसिंहासनस्थितम् ॥ 179 ॥
2.16.m:
a thousand yojanas in extent, and completely filled with servants.
Brahmā, together with Śaṅkara and the gods, beheld Lord Hari,
seated in its center like Indra surrounded by stars,
seated on a wonderful lion-throne fashioned of priceless gems,

2.16.s:
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ ca caturbhujam .. .. 175 ..
2.16.d:
किरीटिनं कुण्डलिनं वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधारिणं च चतुर्भुजम् ॥ ॥ 175 ॥
2.16.m: bearing the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, and four-armed,

2.16.s:
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam ..
amūlyaratnanirmāṇasarvābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 177 ..
2.16.d:
नवीननीरदश्यामं सुन्दरं सुमनोहरम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणसर्वाभरणभूषितम् ॥ 177 ॥
2.16.m:
dark like a fresh raincloud, handsome and intensely charming,
adorned with all kinds of ornaments crafted from priceless jewels,

2.16.s:
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bibhrataṃ kelipaṅkajam ..
purato nṛtyagītaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā .. 178 ..
2.16.d:
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं बिभ्रतं केलिपङ्कजम् ॥
पुरतो नृत्यगीतं च पश्यन्तं सस्मितं मुदा ॥ 178 ॥
2.16.m:
his whole body anointed with sandalwood paste, holding a play-lotus,
smilingly and joyfully watching the dancing and singing before him,

2.16.s:
śāntaṃ sarasvatīkāntaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāmbujam ..
bhaktapradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam .. 179 ..
2.16.d:
शान्तं सरस्वतीकान्तं लक्ष्मीधृतपदाम्बुजम् ॥
भक्तप्रदत्तताम्बूलं भुक्तवन्तं सुवासितम् ॥ 179 ॥
2.16.m:
tranquil, the beloved of Sarasvatī, his lotus feet grasped by Lakṣmī,
having enjoyed fragrant betel offered by his devotees,

2.16.s:
gaṅgayā parayā bhaktyā sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ..
sarvaiśca stūyamānaṃ ca bhaktinamrātmakandharaiḥ .. 2.16.180 ..
2.16.d:
गङ्गया परया भक्त्या सेवितं श्वेतचामरैः ॥
सर्वैश्च स्तूयमानं च भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरैः ॥ 2.16.180 ॥
2.16.m:
served by Gaṅgā with supreme devotion using white fly-whisks,
and being praised by all, whose necks were bowed in devotion.

2.16.s:
evaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ..
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve praṇamya tuṣṭuvustadā .. 181 ..
2.16.d:
एवं विशिष्टं तं दृष्ट्वा परिपूर्णतमं विभुम् ॥
ब्रह्मादयः सुराः सर्वे प्रणम्य तुष्टुवुस्तदा ॥ 181 ॥
2.16.m:
Having thus seen that distinguished, most complete, all-pervading Lord,
Brahmā and all the other gods then bowed down and praised [him],

2.16.s:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgāḥ sāśrunetrāḥ sagadgadāḥ ..
bhaktyā paramayā bhaktā bhītā namrātmakandharāḥ .. 182 ..
2.16.d:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गाः साश्रुनेत्राः सगद्गदाः ॥
भक्त्या परमया भक्ता भीता नम्रात्मकन्धराः ॥ 182 ॥
2.16.m:
their entire bodies thrilled with horripilation, their eyes filled with tears, their voices faltering,
devoted with supreme devotion, fearful, their necks bent low.

2.16.s:
puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā vidhātā jagatāmapi ..
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa vinayena hareḥ puraḥ .. 183 ..
2.16.d:
पुटाञ्जलियुतो भूत्वा विधाता जगतामपि ॥
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास विनयेन हरेः पुरः ॥ 183 ॥
2.16.m:
Folding his hands in reverence, the creator of even the worlds
related the matter with humility before Hari.

2.16.s:
haristadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvavit ..
prahasyovāca brahmāṇaṃ rahasyaṃ ca manoharam .. 184 ..
2.16.d:
हरिस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वज्ञः सर्वभाववित् ॥
प्रहस्योवाच ब्रह्माणं रहस्यं च मनोहरम् ॥ 184 ॥
2.16.m:
Hearing his speech, Hari, the omniscient knower of all sentiments,
smiled and spoke a charming secret to Brahmā.

2.16.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
śaṅkhacūḍasya vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmi padmaja ..
madbhaktasya ca gopasya mahātejasvinaḥ purā .. 185 ..
2.16.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
शङ्खचूडस्य वृत्तान्तं सर्वं जानामि पद्मज ॥
मद्भक्तस्य च गोपस्य महातेजस्विनः पुरा ॥ 185 ॥
2.16.m:
"I know the entire story of Śaṅkhacūḍa, O lotus-born one,
who was previously my devotee, a cowherd endowed with great brilliance.

2.16.s:
surāḥ śṛṇuta tatsarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
golokasyaiva caritaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakāraṇam .. 186 ..
2.16.d:
सुराः शृणुत तत्सर्वमितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
गोलोकस्यैव चरितं पापघ्नं पुण्यकारणम् ॥ 186 ॥
2.16.m:
Hear that whole ancient account, O gods,
the deed of Goloka itself, destroying sin and producing merit.

2.16.s:
sudāmā nāma gopaśca pārṣadapravaro mama ..
sa prāpa dānavīṃ yoniṃ rādhāśāpātsudāruṇāt .. 187 ..
2.16.d:
सुदामा नाम गोपश्च पार्षदप्रवरो मम ॥
स प्राप दानवीं योनिं राधाशापात्सुदारुणात् ॥ 187 ॥
2.16.m:
There was a cowherd named Sudāman, the foremost of my attendants;
he attained a demonic womb due to a severe curse from Rādhā.

2.16.s:
tatraikadā'hamagamaṃ svālayādrāsamaṇḍalam ..
vihāya māninīṃ rādhāṃ mama prāṇādhikāṃ parām .. 188 ..
2.16.d:
तत्रैकदाऽहमगमं स्वालयाद्रासमण्डलम् ॥
विहाय मानिनीं राधां मम प्राणाधिकां पराम् ॥ 188 ॥
2.16.m:
Once there, I went from my abode to the arena of the rāsa-dance,
having left aside haughty Rādhā, who is dearer to me than life itself, the highest goddess.

2.16.s:
sā māṃ virajayā sārddhaṃ vijñāya kiṃkarīmukhāt ..
paścātkrudhā sā''jagāma māṃ dadarśa ca tatra ca .. 189..
2.16.d:
सा मां विरजया सार्द्धं विज्ञाय किंकरीमुखात् ॥
पश्चात्क्रुधा सा'ऽजगाम मां ददर्श च तत्र च ॥ 189॥
2.16.m:
Having learned from the mouth of a handmaid that I was with Virajā,
she subsequently arrived in anger, and saw me there.

2.16.s:
virajāṃ ca nadīrūpāṃ māṃ jñātvā ca tirohitam ..
punarjagāma sā ruṣṭā svālayaṃ sakhibhiḥ saha .. 2.16.190 ..
2.16.d:
विरजां च नदीरूपां मां ज्ञात्वा च तिरोहितम् ॥
पुनर्जगाम सा रुष्टा स्वालयं सखिभिः सह ॥ 2.16.190 ॥
2.16.m:
Knowing Virajā had taken the form of a river and that I had disappeared,
she, enraged, went back to her own abode with her companions.

2.16.s:
māṃ dṛṣṭvā mandire devī sudāma sahitaṃ purā ..
bhṛśaṃ māṃ bhartsayāmāsa maunībhūtaṃ ca susthiram .. 191 ..
2.16.d:
मां दृष्ट्वा मन्दिरे देवी सुदाम सहितं पुरा ॥
भृशं मां भर्त्सयामास मौनीभूतं च सुस्थिरम् ॥ 191 ॥
2.16.m:
Seeing me formerly in the temple, accompanied by Sudāman, the goddess,
harshly rebuked me while I remained silent and utterly still.

2.16.s:
tac tvā ca sumahāṃśca sudāmā tāṃ cukopa ha..
sa ca tāṃ bhartsayāmāsa kopena mama sannidhau..192..
2.16.d:
तच् त्वा च सुमहांश्च सुदामा तां चुकोप ह॥
स च तां भर्त्सयामास कोपेन मम सन्निधौ॥192॥
2.16.m:
Hearing that, the very mighty Sudāman grew angry at her,
and he rebuked her with rage in my presence.

2.16.s:
tacchrutvā sā kopayuktā raktapaṅkajalocanā ..
bahiṣkartuṃ cakārājñāṃ saṃtrastā mama saṃsadi..193..
2.16.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सा कोपयुक्ता रक्तपङ्कजलोचना ॥
बहिष्कर्तुं चकाराज्ञां संत्रस्ता मम संसदि॥193॥
2.16.m:
Hearing that, she, filled with wrath, her eyes like red lotuses,"
terrified, she ordered him to be cast out from my assembly.

2.16.s:
sakhīlakṣaṃ samuttasthau durvāraṃ tejasojjvalam ..
bahiścakāra taṃ tūrṇaṃ jalpantaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 194 ..
2.16.d:
सखीलक्षं समुत्तस्थौ दुर्वारं तेजसोज्ज्वलम् ॥
बहिश्चकार तं तूर्णं जल्पन्तं च पुनः पुनः ॥ 194 ॥
2.16.m:
A hundred thousand female companions arose, irresistible and blazing with splendour;
they quickly threw him out as he kept chattering again and again.

2.16.s:
sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā samāruṣṭā śaśāpa tam ..
yāhi re dānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ ..195..
2.16.d:
सा च तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा समारुष्टा शशाप तम् ॥
याहि रे दानवीं योनिमित्येवं दारुणं वचः ॥195॥
2.16.m:
And hearing his words, she was enraged and cursed him
with these cruel words: “Enter the womb of a Dānava!”

2.16.s:
taṃ gacchantaṃ śapantaṃ ca rudantaṃ māṃ praṇamya ca ..
vārayāmāsa sā tuṣṭā rudantī kṛpayā punaḥ .. 196 ..
2.16.d:
तं गच्छन्तं शपन्तं च रुदन्तं मां प्रणम्य च ॥
वारयामास सा तुष्टा रुदन्ती कृपया पुनः ॥ 196 ॥
2.16.m:
As he was departing, cursing, crying, and bowing down to me,
she, relenting, restrained him again, weeping out of compassion:

2.16.s:
he vatsa tiṣṭha mā gaccha kva yāsīti punaḥ punaḥ ..
samuccāryya ca tatpaścājjagāma sā ca vismitā .. 197 ..
2.16.d:
हे वत्स तिष्ठ मा गच्छ क्व यासीति पुनः पुनः ॥
समुच्चार्य्य च तत्पश्चाज्जगाम सा च विस्मिता ॥ 197 ॥
2.16.m:
“O child, stay! Do not go! Where are you going?”—uttering this
again and again, she then followed after him in astonishment.

2.16.s:
gopyaśca ruruduḥ sarvā gopāśceti suduḥkhitāḥ ..
te sarve rādhikā cāpi tatpaścādbodhitā mayā .. 198 ..
2.16.d:
गोप्यश्च रुरुदुः सर्वा गोपाश्चेति सुदुःखिताः ॥
ते सर्वे राधिका चापि तत्पश्चाद्बोधिता मया ॥ 198 ॥
2.16.m:
All the cowherd women and the cowherds wept, deeply sorrowful.
After that, they all, and Rādhikā as well, were consoled by me:

2.16.s:
āyāsyati kṣaṇārdhena kṛtvā śāpasya pālanam ..
sudāmaṃstvamihāgacchetyuvāca sā nivāritā .. 199 ..
2.16.d:
आयास्यति क्षणार्धेन कृत्वा शापस्य पालनम् ॥
सुदामंस्त्वमिहागच्छेत्युवाच सा निवारिता ॥ 199 ॥
2.16.m:
“In half a moment he will return, having fulfilled the curse.
O Sudāman, come here!” she said, having been held back.

2.16.s:
golokasya kṣaṇārddhena caikamanvantaraṃ bhavet ..
pṛthivyāṃ jagatāṃ dhātarityevaṃ vacanaṃ dhruvam .. 2.16.200 ..
2.16.d:
गोलोकस्य क्षणार्द्धेन चैकमन्वन्तरं भवेत् ॥
पृथिव्यां जगतां धातरित्येवं वचनं ध्रुवम् ॥ 2.16.200 ॥
2.16.m:
Half a moment in Goloka equals one manvantara
on earth, O Creator of the worlds! Such is the certain rule.

2.16.s:
sa eva śaṃkhacūḍaśca punastatraiva yāsyati ..
mahābaliṣṭho yogīśaḥ sarvamāyāviśāradaḥ ..201..
2.16.d:
स एव शंखचूडश्च पुनस्तत्रैव यास्यति ॥
महाबलिष्ठो योगीशः सर्वमायाविशारदः ॥201॥
2.16.m:
That very Śaṅkhacūḍa shall return right here;
he is very mighty, a master of yoga, skilled in all illusions.

2.16.s:
mama śūlaṃ gṛhītvā ca śīghraṃ gacchata bhāratam ..
śivaḥ karotu saṃhāraṃ mama śūlena rakṣasaḥ .. 202 ..
2.16.d:
मम शूलं गृहीत्वा च शीघ्रं गच्छत भारतम् ॥
शिवः करोतु संहारं मम शूलेन रक्षसः ॥ 202 ॥
2.16.m:
Taking my trident, go quickly to Bhārata;
let Śiva destroy the demon with my trident.

2.16.s:
mamaiva kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ..
bibharti dānavaḥ śaśvatsaṃpāravijayī tataḥ ..203 ..
2.16.d:
ममैव कवचं कण्ठे सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गलम् ॥
बिभर्ति दानवः शश्वत्संपारविजयी ततः ॥203 ॥
2.16.m:
Around his neck, the Dānava constantly wears my own armour,
the most auspicious of all, conqueror of the world; therefore

2.16.s:
tatra brahmansthite kaṇṭhe na ko'pi hiṃsituṃ kṣamaḥ ..
tadyāñcāṃ ca kariṣyāmi viprarūpo'hameva ca ..204..
2.16.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मन्स्थिते कण्ठे न कोऽपि हिंसितुं क्षमः ॥
तद्याञ्चां च करिष्यामि विप्ररूपोऽहमेव च ॥204॥
2.16.m:
while it remains on his neck, O Brahman, no one is able to harm him.
And I myself, in the form of a brāhmaṇa, will ask him for it.

2.16.s:
satītvabhaṅgastatpatnyā yatra kāle bhaviṣyati ..
tatraiva kāle tanmṛtyuriti datto varastvayā .. 205 ..
2.16.d:
सतीत्वभङ्गस्तत्पत्न्या यत्र काले भविष्यति ॥
तत्रैव काले तन्मृत्युरिति दत्तो वरस्त्वया ॥ 205 ॥
2.16.m:
At the time when his wife's chastity shall be violated,
at that very time his death will occur—such is the boon granted by you.

2.16.s:
tatpatnyāścodare vīryyamarpayiṣyāmi niścitam ..
tatkṣaṇenaiva tanmṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 206 ..
2.16.d:
तत्पत्न्याश्चोदरे वीर्य्यमर्पयिष्यामि निश्चितम् ॥
तत्क्षणेनैव तन्मृत्युर्भविष्यति न संशयः ॥ 206 ॥
2.16.m:
I will certainly deposit my semen into his wife's womb;
at that very instant his death will occur, without doubt.

2.16.s:
paścātsā dehamutsṛjya bhaviṣyati priyā mama ..
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho dadau śūlaṃ harāya ca ..207..
2.16.d:
पश्चात्सा देहमुत्सृज्य भविष्यति प्रिया मम ॥
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथो ददौ शूलं हराय च ॥207॥
2.16.m:
Afterwards, giving up her body, she will become my beloved.”
Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds gave the trident to Hara.

2.16.s:
śūlaṃ dattvā yayau śīghraṃ harirabhyantaraṃ mudā ..
bhārataṃ ca yayurdevā brahmarudrapurogamāḥ .. 208 ..
2.16.d:
शूलं दत्त्वा ययौ शीघ्रं हरिरभ्यन्तरं मुदा ॥
भारतं च ययुर्देवा ब्रह्मरुद्रपुरोगमाः ॥ 208 ॥
2.16.m:
Having given the trident, Hari gladly went inside at once,
and the gods, led by Brahmā and Rudra, departed for Bhārata.

2.17.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
brahmā śivaṃ saṃniyojya saṃhāre dānavasya ca ..
jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ yathāsthānaṃ mahāmune .. 1 ..
2.17.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
ब्रह्मा शिवं संनियोज्य संहारे दानवस्य च ॥
जगाम स्वालयं तूर्णं यथास्थानं महामुने ॥ 1 ॥

2.17.s:
candrabhāgānadītīre vaṭamūle manohare ..
tatra tasthau mahādevo devanistārahetave .. 2 ..
2.17.d:
चन्द्रभागानदीतीरे वटमूले मनोहरे ॥
तत्र तस्थौ महादेवो देवनिस्तारहेतवे ॥ 2 ॥

2.17.s:
dūtaṃ kṛtvā puṣpadantaṃ gandharveśvaramīpsitam ..
śīghraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa śaṃkhacūḍāntikaṃ mudā .. 3 ..
2.17.d:
दूतं कृत्वा पुष्पदन्तं गन्धर्वेश्वरमीप्सितम् ॥
शीघ्रं प्रस्थापयामास शंखचूडान्तिकं मुदा ॥ 3 ॥

2.17.s:
sa ceśvarājñayā śīghraṃ yayau tannagaraṃ varam ..
mahendranagarotkṛṣṭaṃ kuberabhavanādhikam .. 4 ..
2.17.d:
स चेश्वराज्ञया शीघ्रं ययौ तन्नगरं वरम् ॥
महेन्द्रनगरोत्कृष्टं कुबेरभवनाधिकम् ॥ 4 ॥

2.17.s:
pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye taddviguṇaṃ mune ..
sphāṭikākāramaṇibhissamantātpariveṣṭitam ..
saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca durgamābhiḥ samanvitam .. 5 ..
2.17.d:
पञ्चयोजनविस्तीर्णं दैर्घ्ये तद्द्विगुणं मुने ॥
स्फाटिकाकारमणिभिस्समन्तात्परिवेष्टितम् ॥
सप्तभिः परिखाभिश्च दुर्गमाभिः समन्वितम् ॥ 5 ॥

2.17.s:
jvaladagninibhairnityaṃ śobhitaṃ ratnakoṭibhiḥ ..
yuktaṃ ca vīthiśatakairmaṇivedisamanvitaiḥ .. 6 ..
2.17.d:
ज्वलदग्निनिभैर्नित्यं शोभितं रत्नकोटिभिः ॥
युक्तं च वीथिशतकैर्मणिवेदिसमन्वितैः ॥ 6 ॥

2.17.s:
parito vaṇijāṃ saṃghairnānāvastuvirājitaiḥ ..
sindūrākāramaṇibhirnirmitaiśca vicitritaiḥ .. 7 ..
2.17.d:
परितो वणिजां संघैर्नानावस्तुविराजितैः ॥
सिन्दूराकारमणिभिर्निर्मितैश्च विचित्रितैः ॥ 7 ॥

2.17.s:
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairdivyairāśramaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ ..
gatvā dadarśa tanmadhye śaṅkhacūḍālayaṃ varam .. 8 ..
2.17.d:
भूषितं भूषितैर्दिव्यैराश्रमैः शतकोटिभिः ॥
गत्वा ददर्श तन्मध्ये शङ्खचूडालयं वरम् ॥ 8 ॥

2.17.s:
atīva valayākāraṃ yathā pūrṇendumaṇḍalam ..
jvaladagniśikhābhiśca parikhābhiścatasṛbhiḥ..9..
2.17.d:
अतीव वलयाकारं यथा पूर्णेन्दुमण्डलम् ॥
ज्वलदग्निशिखाभिश्च परिखाभिश्चतसृभिः॥9॥

2.17.s:
sudurgamaṃ ca śatrūṇāmanyeṣāṃ sugamaṃ sukham ..
atyuccairgaganasparśyamaṇiprācīraveṣṭitam..2.17.10..
2.17.d:
सुदुर्गमं च शत्रूणामन्येषां सुगमं सुखम् ॥
अत्युच्चैर्गगनस्पर्श्यमणिप्राचीरवेष्टितम्॥2.17.10॥

2.17.s:
rājitaṃ dvādaśadvārairdvārapālasamanvitaiḥ ..
ratnakṛtrimapadmāḍhyai ratnadarpaṇabhūṣitaiḥ ..11 ..
2.17.d:
राजितं द्वादशद्वारैर्द्वारपालसमन्वितैः ॥
रत्नकृत्रिमपद्माढ्यै रत्नदर्पणभूषितैः ॥11 ॥

2.17.s:
maṇīndrasārakhacitaiḥ śobhitaṃ lakṣamandiraiḥ..
śobhitaṃ ratnasopānai ratnastambhavirājitaiḥ ..12..
2.17.d:
मणीन्द्रसारखचितैः शोभितं लक्षमन्दिरैः॥
शोभितं रत्नसोपानै रत्नस्तम्भविराजितैः ॥12॥

2.17.s:
ratnacitrakapāṭādyaiḥ sadratnakalaśānvitaiḥ..
ratnendracitrarājībhiḥ sudīptābhirvirājitaiḥ..13..
2.17.d:
रत्नचित्रकपाटाद्यैः सद्रत्नकलशान्वितैः॥
रत्नेन्द्रचित्रराजीभिः सुदीप्ताभिर्विराजितैः॥13॥

2.17.s:
parito rakṣitaṃ śaśvaddānavaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ..
divyāstradhāribhiḥ śūrairmahābalaparākramaiḥ..14..
2.17.d:
परितो रक्षितं शश्वद्दानवैः शतकोटिभिः॥
दिव्यास्त्रधारिभिः शूरैर्महाबलपराक्रमैः॥14॥

2.17.s:
sundaraiśca suveṣaiśca nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaiḥ ..
tāndṛṣṭvā puṣpadanto'pi varadvāraṃ dadarśa saḥ .. 15 ..
2.17.d:
सुन्दरैश्च सुवेषैश्च नानालङ्कारभूषितैः ॥
तान्दृष्ट्वा पुष्पदन्तोऽपि वरद्वारं ददर्श सः ॥ 15 ॥

2.17.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ puruṣaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sasmitam ..
tiṣṭhantaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ ca tāmravarṇaṃ bhayaṅkaram .. 16 ..
2.17.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं पुरुषं शूलहस्तं च सस्मितम् ॥
तिष्ठन्तं पिङ्गलाक्षं च ताम्रवर्णं भयङ्करम् ॥ 16 ॥

2.17.s:
kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ jagāma tadanujñayā ..
atikramya navadvāraṃ jagāmābhyantaraṃ puram .. 17 ..
2.17.d:
कथयामास वृत्तान्तं जगाम तदनुज्ञया ॥
अतिक्रम्य नवद्वारं जगामाभ्यन्तरं पुरम् ॥ 17 ॥

2.17.s:
na kaiścidvārito dūto dūtarūpeṇa tasya ca ..
gatvā so'bhyantaraṃ dvāraṃ dvārapālamuvāca ha .. 18 ..
2.17.d:
न कैश्चिद्वारितो दूतो दूतरूपेण तस्य च ॥
गत्वा सोऽभ्यन्तरं द्वारं द्वारपालमुवाच ह ॥ 18 ॥

2.17.s:
raṇasya sarvavṛttāntaṃ vijñāpayitumīśvaram ..
sa ca taṃ kathayitvā ca dūtaṃ gantumuvāca ha .. 19 ..
2.17.d:
रणस्य सर्ववृत्तान्तं विज्ञापयितुमीश्वरम् ॥
स च तं कथयित्वा च दूतं गन्तुमुवाच ह ॥ 19 ॥

2.17.s:
sa gatvā śaṃkhacūḍaṃ taṃ dadarśa sumanoharam ..
rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitam .. 2.17.20 ..
2.17.d:
स गत्वा शंखचूडं तं ददर्श सुमनोहरम् ॥
रासमण्डलमध्यस्थं स्वर्णसिंहासनस्थितम् ॥ 2.17.20 ॥

2.17.s:
maṇīndrakhacitaṃ citraṃ ratnadaṇḍasamanvitam ..
ratnakṛtrimapuṣpaiśca praśastaṃ śobhitaṃ sadā .. 21 ..
2.17.d:
मणीन्द्रखचितं चित्रं रत्नदण्डसमन्वितम् ॥
रत्नकृत्रिमपुष्पैश्च प्रशस्तं शोभितं सदा ॥ 21 ॥

2.17.s:
bhṛtyena hastavidhṛtaṃ svarṇacchatraṃ manoharam ..
sevitaṃ pārṣadagaṇairvyajanaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ .. 22 ..
2.17.d:
भृत्येन हस्तविधृतं स्वर्णच्छत्रं मनोहरम् ॥
सेवितं पार्षदगणैर्व्यजनैः श्वेतचामरैः ॥ 22 ॥

2.17.s:
suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
mālyānulepanaṃ sūkṣmavastraṃ ca dadhataṃ mune .. 23 ..
2.17.d:
सुवेषं सुन्दरं रम्यं रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥
माल्यानुलेपनं सूक्ष्मवस्त्रं च दधतं मुने ॥ 23 ॥

2.17.s:
dānavendraiḥ parivṛtaṃ suveṣaṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ..
śatakoṭibhiranyaiśca bhramadbhiśśastradhāribhiḥ .. 24 ..
2.17.d:
दानवेन्द्रैः परिवृतं सुवेषं च त्रिकोटिभिः ॥
शतकोटिभिरन्यैश्च भ्रमद्भिश्शस्त्रधारिभिः ॥ 24 ॥

2.17.s:
evaṃbhūtaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṣpadantaḥ savismayaḥ ..
uvāca raṇavṛttāntaṃ yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇa ca .. 25 ..
2.17.d:
एवंभूतं च तं दृष्ट्वा पुष्पदन्तः सविस्मयः ॥
उवाच रणवृत्तान्तं यदुक्तं शङ्करेण च ॥ 25 ॥

2.17.s:
puṣpadanta uvāca ..
rājendra śivadūto'haṃ puṣpadantābhidhaḥ prabho ..
yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇaiva tadbravīmi niśāmaya .. 26 ..
2.17.d:
पुष्पदन्त उवाच ॥
राजेन्द्र शिवदूतोऽहं पुष्पदन्ताभिधः प्रभो ॥
यदुक्तं शङ्करेणैव तद्ब्रवीमि निशामय ॥ 26 ॥

2.17.s:
rājyaṃ dehi ca devānāmadhikāraṃ ca sāmpratam ..
devāśca śaraṇāpannā deveśe śrīharau pare .. 27 ..
2.17.d:
राज्यं देहि च देवानामधिकारं च साम्प्रतम् ॥
देवाश्च शरणापन्ना देवेशे श्रीहरौ परे ॥ 27 ॥

2.17.s:
dattvā triśūlaṃ hariṇā tubhyaṃ prasthāpitaḥ śivaḥ ..
candrabhāgānadītīre vaṭamūle trilocanaḥ ..28..
2.17.d:
दत्त्वा त्रिशूलं हरिणा तुभ्यं प्रस्थापितः शिवः ॥
चन्द्रभागानदीतीरे वटमूले त्रिलोचनः ॥28॥

2.17.s:
viṣayaṃ dehi teṣāṃ ca yuddhaṃ vā kuru niścitam ..
gatvā vakṣyāmi kiṃ śambhuṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati .. 29 ..
2.17.d:
विषयं देहि तेषां च युद्धं वा कुरु निश्चितम् ॥
गत्वा वक्ष्यामि किं शम्भुं तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥ 29 ॥

2.17.s:
dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhacūḍaḥ prahasya ca ..
prabhāte hyāgamiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca gacchetyuvāca ha .. 2.17.30 ..
2.17.d:
दूतस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा शङ्खचूडः प्रहस्य च ॥
प्रभाते ह्यागमिष्यामि त्वं च गच्छेत्युवाच ह ॥ 2.17.30 ॥

2.17.s:
sa gatvovāca tūrṇaṃ taṃ vaṭamūlasthamīśvaram ..
śaṅkhacūḍasya vacanaṃ tadīyaṃ yatparicchadam ..31..
2.17.d:
स गत्वोवाच तूर्णं तं वटमूलस्थमीश्वरम् ॥
शङ्खचूडस्य वचनं तदीयं यत्परिच्छदम् ॥31॥

2.17.s:
etasminnantare skanda ājagāma śivāntikam ..
vīrabhadraśca nandī ca mahākālaḥ subhadrakaḥ .. 32 ..
2.17.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे स्कन्द आजगाम शिवान्तिकम् ॥
वीरभद्रश्च नन्दी च महाकालः सुभद्रकः ॥ 32 ॥

2.17.s:
viśālākṣaśca bāṇaśca piṅgalākṣo vikampanaḥ ..
virūpo vikṛtiścaiva maṇibhadraśca bāṣkalaḥ..33..
2.17.d:
विशालाक्षश्च बाणश्च पिङ्गलाक्षो विकम्पनः ॥
विरूपो विकृतिश्चैव मणिभद्रश्च बाष्कलः॥33॥

2.17.s:
kapilākṣo dīrghadaṃṣṭro vikaṭastāmralocanaḥ ..
kālaṅkaṭo balībhadraḥ kālajihvaḥ kuṭīcaraḥ ..34..
2.17.d:
कपिलाक्षो दीर्घदंष्ट्रो विकटस्ताम्रलोचनः ॥
कालङ्कटो बलीभद्रः कालजिह्वः कुटीचरः ॥34॥

2.17.s:
balonmatto raṇaślāghī durjayo durgamastathā ..
aṣṭau ca bhairavā raudrā rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
2.17.d:
बलोन्मत्तो रणश्लाघी दुर्जयो दुर्गमस्तथा ॥
अष्टौ च भैरवा रौद्रा रुद्राश्चैकादश स्मृताः ॥ 39 ॥

2.17.s:
vasavo vāsavādyāśca ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ..
hutāśanaśca candraśca viśvakarmā'śvinau ca tau ..36..
2.17.d:
वसवो वासवाद्याश्च आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः ॥
हुताशनश्च चन्द्रश्च विश्वकर्माऽश्विनौ च तौ ॥36॥

2.17.s:
kuberaśca yamaścaiva jayanto nalakūbaraḥ ..
vāyuśca varuṇaścaiva budho vai maṃgalastathā .. .. 37 ..
2.17.d:
कुबेरश्च यमश्चैव जयन्तो नलकूबरः ॥
वायुश्च वरुणश्चैव बुधो वै मंगलस्तथा ॥ ॥ 37 ॥

2.17.s:
dharmaśca śanirīśānaḥ kāmadevaśca vīryyavān ..
ugradaṃṣṭrā cogracaṇḍā koṭṭarī kaiṭabhī tathā .. 38 ..
2.17.d:
धर्मश्च शनिरीशानः कामदेवश्च वीर्य्यवान् ॥
उग्रदंष्ट्रा चोग्रचण्डा कोट्टरी कैटभी तथा ॥ 38 ॥

2.17.s:
svayaṃ śatabhujā devī bhadrakālī bhayaṃkarī ..
ratnendrarājakhacitavimānopari saṃsthitā .. 39 ..
2.17.d:
स्वयं शतभुजा देवी भद्रकाली भयंकरी ॥
रत्नेन्द्रराजखचितविमानोपरि संस्थिता ॥ 39 ॥

2.17.s:
raktavastraparīdhānā raktamālyānulepanā ..
nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca gāyantī susvaraṃ mudā ..2.17.40..
2.17.d:
रक्तवस्त्रपरीधाना रक्तमाल्यानुलेपना ॥
नृत्यन्ती च हसन्ती च गायन्ती सुस्वरं मुदा ॥2.17.40॥

2.17.s:
abhayaṃ dadatī bhaktamabhayā sā bhayaṃ ripum ..
bibhratī vikaṭāṃ jihvāṃ sulolāṃ yojanāyatām .. .. 41 ..
2.17.d:
अभयं ददती भक्तमभया सा भयं रिपुम् ॥
बिभ्रती विकटां जिह्वां सुलोलां योजनायताम् ॥ ॥ 41 ॥

2.17.s:
kharparaṃ vartulākāraṃ gambhīraṃ yojanāyatam ..
triśūlaṃ gaganasparśiṃ śaktiṃ vai yojanāyatām .. 42 ..
2.17.d:
खर्परं वर्तुलाकारं गम्भीरं योजनायतम् ॥
त्रिशूलं गगनस्पर्शिं शक्तिं वै योजनायताम् ॥ 42 ॥

2.17.s:
śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śarāṃścāpaṃ bhayaṃkaram ..
mudgaraṃ muśalaṃ vajraṃ khaḍgaṃ phalakamujjvalam .. 43 ..
2.17.d:
शंखं चक्रं गदां पद्मं शरांश्चापं भयंकरम् ॥
मुद्गरं मुशलं वज्रं खड्गं फलकमुज्ज्वलम् ॥ 43 ॥

2.17.s:
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ vāruṇāstramāgneyaṃ nāgapāśakam ..
nārāyaṇāstraṃ brahmāstraṃ gāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā .. 44 ..
2.17.d:
वैष्णवास्त्रं वारुणास्त्रमाग्नेयं नागपाशकम् ॥
नारायणास्त्रं ब्रह्मास्त्रं गान्धर्वं गारुडं तथा ॥ 44 ॥
2.17.m: the Nārāyaṇa missile, the weapon of Brahmā, and likewise the Gāndharva and Gāruḍa,

2.17.s:
pārjanyaṃ vai pāśupataṃ jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ ca pārvatam ..
māheśvarāstraṃ vāyavyaṃ daṇḍaṃ sammohanaṃ tathā ..
nānāvidhānyāyudhāni divyāstraśatakaṃ param ..45..
2.17.d:
पार्जन्यं वै पाशुपतं जृम्भणास्त्रं च पार्वतम् ॥
माहेश्वरास्त्रं वायव्यं दण्डं सम्मोहनं तथा ॥
नानाविधान्यायुधानि दिव्यास्त्रशतकं परम् ॥45॥
2.17.m:
the Pārjanya, indeed the Pāśupata, the yawn-missile, and the mountain missile,
the Māheśvara missile, the Vāyavya, the staff, and likewise the delusion-missile,
and various kinds of weapons, a hundred supreme divine missiles.

2.17.s:
āgatya tatra tasthau sā yoginīnāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ vai ḍākinīnāṃ ca vikaṭānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ .. 46 ..
2.17.d:
आगत्य तत्र तस्थौ सा योगिनीनां त्रिकोटिभिः ॥
सार्द्धं वै डाकिनीनां च विकटानां त्रिकोटिभिः ॥ 46 ॥
2.17.m:
She arrived and stood there with thirty million Yoginīs,
together with thirty million terrifying Ḍākinīs.

2.17.s:
bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍabrahmarākṣasāḥ ..
vetālāścaiva yakṣāśca rākṣasāścaiva kinnarāḥ .. 47 ..
2.17.d:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाश्च कूष्माण्डब्रह्मराक्षसाः ॥
वेतालाश्चैव यक्षाश्च राक्षसाश्चैव किन्नराः ॥ 47 ॥
2.17.m: vetālas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and kinnaras—

2.17.s:
tābhiścaiva saha skando natvā vai candraśekharam ..
pituḥ pārśve sabhāyāṃ ca samuvāsa bhavājñayā .. 48 ..
2.17.d:
ताभिश्चैव सह स्कन्दो नत्वा वै चन्द्रशेखरम् ॥
पितुः पार्श्वे सभायां च समुवास भवाज्ञया ॥ 48 ॥
2.17.m:
along with them Skanda bowed to Candraśekhara,
and sat beside his father in the assembly by the command of Bhava.

2.17.s:
atha dūte gate tatra śaṃkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān..
uvāca tulasīṃ vārttāṃ gatvā'bhyantarameva ca ..49..
2.17.d:
अथ दूते गते तत्र शंखचूडः प्रतापवान्॥
उवाच तुलसीं वार्त्तां गत्वाऽभ्यन्तरमेव च ॥49॥
2.17.m:
Then, when the messenger had departed, the majestic Śaṅkhacūḍa
went into the inner chambers and spoke news to Tulasī.

2.17.s:
raṇavārttāṃ ca sā śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ..
uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī hṛdayena vidūyatā ..2.17.50..
2.17.d:
रणवार्त्तां च सा श्रुत्वा शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुका ॥
उवाच मधुरं साध्वी हृदयेन विदूयता ॥2.17.50॥
2.17.m:
Hearing the news of battle, her throat, lips, and palate parched,
the virtuous woman spoke sweetly with an anguished heart.

2.17.s:
tulasyuvāca ..
he prāṇanātha he bandho tiṣṭha me vakṣasi kṣaṇam ..
he prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeva rakṣa me jīvanaṃ kṣaṇam ..91..
2.17.d:
तुलस्युवाच ॥
हे प्राणनाथ हे बन्धो तिष्ठ मे वक्षसि क्षणम् ॥
हे प्राणाधिष्ठातृदेव रक्ष मे जीवनं क्षणम् ॥91॥
2.17.m:
O lord of my life, O friend, remain upon my breast for a moment.
O deity presiding over my breath, protect my life for a moment.

2.17.s:
bhuṃkṣva janmasu bhogyaṃ tadyadvai manasi vāṃchitam ..
paśyāmi tvāṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñcillocanābhyāṃ pipāsitā .. 52 ..
2.17.d:
भुंक्ष्व जन्मसु भोग्यं तद्यद्वै मनसि वांछितम् ॥
पश्यामि त्वां क्षणं किञ्चिल्लोचनाभ्यां पिपासिता ॥ 52 ॥
2.17.m:
Enjoy across births what is to be enjoyed, whatever is desired in your heart.
Thirsty, let me gaze upon you for a moment with both my eyes.

2.17.s:
āndolayanti prāṇā me mano dagdhaṃ ca santatam ..
dussvapnaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ cādyaiva carame niśi .. 53 ..
2.17.d:
आन्दोलयन्ति प्राणा मे मनो दग्धं च सन्ततम् ॥
दुस्स्वप्नं च मया दृष्टं चाद्यैव चरमे निशि ॥ 53 ॥
2.17.m:
My vital breaths tremble, and my mind is constantly ablaze.
An evil dream was seen by me this very day in the final watch of the night.

2.17.s:
tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā bhuktvā pītvā nṛpeśvaraḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ prājño hitaṃ satyaṃ yathocitam ..54..
2.17.d:
तुलसीवचनं श्रुत्वा भुक्त्वा पीत्वा नृपेश्वरः ॥
उवाच वचनं प्राज्ञो हितं सत्यं यथोचितम् ॥54॥
2.17.m:
Hearing Tulasī's words, having eaten and drunk, the lord of kings,
wise, spoke beneficial, true, and fitting words.

2.17.s:
śaṅkhacūḍa uvāca ..
kālena yojitaṃ sarvaṃ karma bhoganibandhane ..
śubhaṃ harṣaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamamaṃgalam ..55..
2.17.d:
शङ्खचूड उवाच ॥
कालेन योजितं सर्वं कर्म भोगनिबन्धने ॥
शुभं हर्षं सुखं दुःखं भयं शोकममंगलम् ॥55॥
2.17.m:
All action is bound by time to the experience of its fruits:
good fortune, joy, pleasure, pain, fear, sorrow, and misfortune.

2.17.s:
kāle bhavanti vṛkṣāśca śākhāvantaśca kālataḥ ..
krameṇa puṣpavantaśca phalavantaśca kālataḥ ..56..
2.17.d:
काले भवन्ति वृक्षाश्च शाखावन्तश्च कालतः ॥
क्रमेण पुष्पवन्तश्च फलवन्तश्च कालतः ॥56॥
2.17.m:
In time trees come to be, and through time they branch out;
in due course they blossom, and through time they bear fruit.

2.17.s:
teṣāṃ phalāni pakvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ ..
te sarve phalinaḥ kāle kāle kālaṃ prayānti ca..57..
2.17.d:
तेषां फलानि पक्वानि प्रभवन्त्येव कालतः ॥
ते सर्वे फलिनः काले काले कालं प्रयान्ति च॥57॥
2.17.m:
Their fruits ripen only through time;
all those fruit-bearing trees come to their end in time, in time.

2.17.s:
bhavanti kāle bhūtāni kāle kālaṃ prayānti ca..
kāle bhavanti viśvāni kāle naśyanti sundari..58..
2.17.d:
भवन्ति काले भूतानि काले कालं प्रयान्ति च॥
काले भवन्ति विश्वानि काले नश्यन्ति सुन्दरि॥58॥
2.17.m:
Beings come to be in time, and in time they meet their end;
in time universes come to be, and in time they perish, beautiful woman.

2.17.s:
sraṣṭā ca kāle sṛjati pātā pāti ca kālataḥ..
saṃharttā saṃharetkāle saṃcaranti krameṇa te ..59..
2.17.d:
स्रष्टा च काले सृजति पाता पाति च कालतः॥
संहर्त्ता संहरेत्काले संचरन्ति क्रमेण ते ॥59॥
2.17.m:
The Creator creates in time, and the Protector protects through time;
the Destroyer destroys in time; they operate in succession.

2.17.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ..
sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃharttā sa kṛtsnāṃśena sarvadā.2.17.60..
2.17.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनामीश्वरः प्रकृतेः परः॥
स्रष्टा पाता च संहर्त्ता स कृत्स्नांशेन सर्वदा.2.17.60॥
2.17.m: He is always the creator, protector, and destroyer through His whole portion.

2.17.s:
kāle sa eva prakṛtiṃ nirmāya svecchayā prabhuḥ..
nirmāya prākṛtānsarvānviśvasthāṃśca carācarān..61..
2.17.d:
काले स एव प्रकृतिं निर्माय स्वेच्छया प्रभुः॥
निर्माय प्राकृतान्सर्वान्विश्वस्थांश्च चराचरान्॥61॥
2.17.m:
In time, having created Prakṛti by His own will, that Lord,
having created all things born of Prakṛti, moving and unmoving, that dwell in the universe,

2.17.s:
ābrahmastaṃbaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimameva ca..
pravadanti ca kālena naśyatyapi hi naśvaram..62..
2.17.d:
आब्रह्मस्तंबपर्य्यन्तं सर्वं कृत्रिममेव च॥
प्रवदन्ति च कालेन नश्यत्यपि हि नश्वरम्॥62॥
2.17.m:
from Brahmā down to a clump of grass—all is indeed artificial.
And they say that in time even the perishable perishes.

2.17.s:
bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam ..
sarveśaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvātmānantamīśvarama..63..
2.17.d:
भज सत्यं परं ब्रह्म राधेशं त्रिगुणात्परम् ॥
सर्वेशं सर्वरूपं च सर्वात्मानन्तमीश्वरम॥63॥
2.17.m: the Lord of all, of all forms, the Self of all, endless, the sovereign.

2.17.s:
jalaṃ jalena sṛjati jalaṃ pāti jalena yaḥ ..
harejjalaṃ jalenaiva taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja santatam ..64..
2.17.d:
जलं जलेन सृजति जलं पाति जलेन यः ॥
हरेज्जलं जलेनैव तं कृष्णं भज सन्ततम् ॥64॥
2.17.m:
He who creates water with water, who preserves water with water,
and takes away water with water alone—worship that Kṛṣṇa constantly.

2.17.s:
yasyājñayā vāti vātaḥ śīghragāmī ca santatam..
yasyājñayā ca tapanastapatyeva yathākṣaṇam .. 65 ..
2.17.d:
यस्याज्ञया वाति वातः शीघ्रगामी च सन्ततम्॥
यस्याज्ञया च तपनस्तपत्येव यथाक्षणम् ॥ 65 ॥
2.17.m:
By whose command the swift-moving wind blows constantly,
by whose command the sun burns precisely according to its appointed time,

2.17.s:
yathākṣaṇaṃ varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu ..
yathākṣaṇaṃ dahatyagniścandro bhramati bhītavat..66..
2.17.d:
यथाक्षणं वर्षतीन्द्रो मृत्युश्चरति जन्तुषु ॥
यथाक्षणं दहत्यग्निश्चन्द्रो भ्रमति भीतवत्॥66॥
2.17.m:
according to the moment Indra rains, death stalks among creatures,
fire burns according to its moment, and the moon wanders like one afraid.

2.17.s:
mṛtyormūlaṃ kālamūlaṃ yamasya ca yamaṃ param..
sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭurapi ca pātuḥ pālakameva ca ..67..
2.17.d:
मृत्योर्मूलं कालमूलं यमस्य च यमं परम्॥
स्रष्टारं स्रष्टुरपि च पातुः पालकमेव च ॥67॥
2.17.m:
The root of death, the root of Time, the supreme Yama of Yama himself,
the Creator of the creator, and the protector of the protector,

2.17.s:
saṃharttāraṃ ca saṃhartustaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja..
ko bandhuścaiva keṣāṃ vā sarvabandhuṃ bhaja priye .. 68 ..
2.17.d:
संहर्त्तारं च संहर्तुस्तं कृष्णं शरणं व्रज॥
को बन्धुश्चैव केषां वा सर्वबन्धुं भज प्रिये ॥ 68 ॥
2.17.m:
and the destroyer of the destroyer—go to that Kṛṣṇa for refuge.
Who is a friend, and of whom? Worship the friend of all, dear one.

2.17.s:
ahaṃ ko vā tvaṃ ca kā vā vidhinā yojitaḥ purā ..
tvayā sārddhaṃ karmaṇā ca punastena viyojitaḥ ..69..
2.17.d:
अहं को वा त्वं च का वा विधिना योजितः पुरा ॥
त्वया सार्द्धं कर्मणा च पुनस्तेन वियोजितः ॥69॥
2.17.m:
Who am I, and who are you? Formerly joined by fate
together with you, by karma [I am] now separated again from you.

2.17.s:
ajñānī kātaraḥ śoke vipattau ca na paṇḍitaḥ ..
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhramatyeva cakranemikrameṇa ca .. .. 2.17.70 ..
2.17.d:
अज्ञानी कातरः शोके विपत्तौ च न पण्डितः ॥
सुखं दुःखं भ्रमत्येव चक्रनेमिक्रमेण च ॥ ॥ 2.17.70 ॥
2.17.m:
An ignorant person is distressed in sorrow and in calamity, not a wise person.
Pleasure and pain revolve like the rim of a wheel.

2.17.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ sarveśaṃ kāntaṃ prāpsyasi niścitam ..
tapaḥ kṛtaṃ yadarthe ca purā badarikāśrame .. 71..
2.17.d:
नारायणं तं सर्वेशं कान्तं प्राप्स्यसि निश्चितम् ॥
तपः कृतं यदर्थे च पुरा बदरिकाश्रमे ॥ 71॥
2.17.m:
You will surely attain that Nārāyaṇa, the Lord of all, as your beloved,
for whose sake austerity was performed formerly at Badarikāśrama.

2.17.s:
mayā tvaṃ tapasā labdhā brahmaṇaśca vareṇa hi ..
harerarthe tava tapo hariṃ prāpsyasi kāmini .. 72 ..
2.17.d:
मया त्वं तपसा लब्धा ब्रह्मणश्च वरेण हि ॥
हरेरर्थे तव तपो हरिं प्राप्स्यसि कामिनि ॥ 72 ॥
2.17.m:
You were obtained by me through ascetic penance, and indeed by the boon of Brahmā.
Your penance was for Hari's sake; you will attain Hari, O charming woman!

2.17.s:
vṛndāvane ca govindaṃ goloke tvaṃ labhiṣyasi ..
ahaṃ yāsyāmi tallokaṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā ca dānavīm .. 73 ..
2.17.d:
वृन्दावने च गोविन्दं गोलोके त्वं लभिष्यसि ॥
अहं यास्यामि तल्लोकं तनुं त्यक्त्वा च दानवीम् ॥ 73 ॥
2.17.m:
You will attain Govinda in Vṛndāvana and in Goloka.
I shall go to that world after abandoning this Dānava body.

2.17.s:
tatra drakṣyasi māṃ tvaṃ ca tvāṃ ca drakṣyāmi santatam ..
āgamaṃ rādhikāśāpādbhārataṃ ca sudurlabham .. 74 ..
2.17.d:
तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि मां त्वं च त्वां च द्रक्ष्यामि सन्ततम् ॥
आगमं राधिकाशापाद्भारतं च सुदुर्लभम् ॥ 74 ॥
2.17.m:
There you will see me, and I will see you constantly.
Because of Rādhikā's curse, I came to Bhārata, which is very hard to attain.

2.17.s:
punaryāsyāmi tatraiva kaḥ śoko me śṛṇu priye ..
tvaṃ hi dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca . ..75..
2.17.d:
पुनर्यास्यामि तत्रैव कः शोको मे शृणु प्रिये ॥
त्वं हि देहं परित्यज्य दिव्यरूपं विधाय च ॥.75॥
2.17.m:
I will go back to that very place; what grief should there be for me? Listen, my beloved!
For abandoning your body and assuming a divine form,

2.17.s:
tatkālaṃ prāpsyasi hariṃ mā kānte kātarā bhava ..
ityuktvā ca dinānte ca tayā sārddhaṃ manohare ..76..
2.17.d:
तत्कालं प्राप्स्यसि हरिं मा कान्ते कातरा भव ॥
इत्युक्त्वा च दिनान्ते च तया सार्द्धं मनोहरे ॥76॥
2.17.m:
you will attain Hari at that time; do not be distressed, O beloved!"
Having spoken thus, at the end of the day, together with her in the charming,

2.17.s:
suṣvāpa śobhane talpe puṣpacandanacarcite ..
nānāprakāravibhave cacāra ratnamandire .. 77 ..
2.17.d:
सुष्वाप शोभने तल्पे पुष्पचन्दनचर्चिते ॥
नानाप्रकारविभवे चचार रत्नमन्दिरे ॥ 77 ॥
2.17.m:
jeweled palace endowed with various kinds of riches, / he slept on a beautiful couch smeared with flowers and sandalwood paste.
He moved about in the jeweled palace,

2.17.s:
ratnapradīpasaṃyukte strīratnaṃ prāpya sundarīm ..
nināya rajanīṃ rājā krīḍākautukamaṃgalaiḥ ..78..
2.17.d:
रत्नप्रदीपसंयुक्ते स्त्रीरत्नं प्राप्य सुन्दरीम् ॥
निनाय रजनीं राजा क्रीडाकौतुकमंगलैः ॥78॥
2.17.m:
furnished with jewel lamps; having obtained that beautiful jewel of a woman,
the king spent the night with the auspicious pleasures of amorous sports.

2.17.s:
kṛtvā vakṣasi kāntāṃ tāṃ rudantīmatiduḥkhitām ..
kṛśodarīṃ nirāhārāṃ nimagnāṃ śokasāgare.79..
2.17.d:
कृत्वा वक्षसि कान्तां तां रुदन्तीमतिदुःखिताम् ॥
कृशोदरीं निराहारां निमग्नां शोकसागरे.79॥
2.17.m:
Taking that weeping, deeply sorrowful beloved to his chest,
slender-waisted, fasting, and plunged into an ocean of grief,

2.17.s:
punastāṃ bodhayāmāsa divyajñānena bodhavit ..
purā kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ bhāṇḍīre tattvamuttamam .. 2.17.80 ..
2.17.d:
पुनस्तां बोधयामास दिव्यज्ञानेन बोधवित् ॥
पुरा कृष्णेन यद्दत्तं भाण्डीरे तत्त्वमुत्तमम् ॥ 2.17.80 ॥
2.17.m:
he, the knower of awakening, comforted her again with divine knowledge.
That supreme truth which was formerly given by Kṛṣṇa in Bhāṇḍīra,

2.17.s:
sa ca tasyai dadau tacca sarvaśokaharaṃ param ..
jñānaṃ saṃprāpya sā devī prasannavadanekṣaṇā .. 81 ..
2.17.d:
स च तस्यै ददौ तच्च सर्वशोकहरं परम् ॥
ज्ञानं संप्राप्य सा देवी प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥ 81 ॥
2.17.m:
he imparted that supreme [truth], which dispels all sorrow, to her.
Having received that knowledge, the goddess, her face and eyes cheerful,

2.17.s:
krīḍāṃ cakāra harṣeṇa sarvaṃ matvā'tinaśvaram ..
tau dampatī ca krīḍārttau nimagnau sukhasāgare .. 82 ..
2.17.d:
क्रीडां चकार हर्षेण सर्वं मत्वाऽतिनश्वरम् ॥
तौ दम्पती च क्रीडार्त्तौ निमग्नौ सुखसागरे ॥ 82 ॥
2.17.m:
made love with joy, considering everything to be utterly transient.
Yearning for love-play, both husband and wife were immersed in an ocean of bliss;

2.17.s:
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgau mūrcchitau nirjane mune ..
aṃgapratyaṃgasaṃyuktau suprītau suratotsukau .. 83 ..
2.17.d:
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गौ मूर्च्छितौ निर्जने मुने ॥
अंगप्रत्यंगसंयुक्तौ सुप्रीतौ सुरतोत्सुकौ ॥ 83 ॥
2.17.m:
all their limbs bristling with thrilling joy, they fainted [in pleasure] in solitude, O sage.
With all their limbs intertwined, highly gratified and eager for intercourse,

2.17.s:
ekāṃgau ca tathā tau dvau cārddhanārīśvarau yathā ..
prāṇeśvaraṃ ca tulasī mene prāṇādhikaṃ param .. 84 ..
2.17.d:
एकांगौ च तथा तौ द्वौ चार्द्धनारीश्वरौ यथा ॥
प्राणेश्वरं च तुलसी मेने प्राणाधिकं परम् ॥ 84 ॥
2.17.m:
the two seemed to have one body, just like Ardhanārīśvara.
Tulasī regarded the lord of her life as supreme, dearer than life itself;

2.17.s:
prāṇādhikāṃ ca tāṃ mene rājā prāṇādhikeśvarīm ..
tau sthitau sukhasuptau ca tantritau sundarau samau .. 85 ..
2.17.d:
प्राणाधिकां च तां मेने राजा प्राणाधिकेश्वरीम् ॥
तौ स्थितौ सुखसुप्तौ च तन्त्रितौ सुन्दरौ समौ ॥ 85 ॥
2.17.m:
and the king regarded her as dearer than life, the sovereign mistress of his life.
They lay sleeping in bliss, weary, beautiful, and equal;

2.17.s:
suveṣau sukhasambhogādaceṣṭau sumanoharau ..
kṣaṇaṃ sacetanau tau ca kathayantau rasāśrayām ..
kathāṃ manoharāṃ divyāṃ hasantau ca kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ .. 86 ..
2.17.d:
सुवेषौ सुखसम्भोगादचेष्टौ सुमनोहरौ ॥
क्षणं सचेतनौ तौ च कथयन्तौ रसाश्रयाम् ॥
कथां मनोहरां दिव्यां हसन्तौ च क्षणं पुनः ॥ 86 ॥
2.17.m:
attractively adorned, motionless from the enjoyment of pleasure, and most charming.
Conscious for a moment, they spoke pleasing,
divine words steeped in aesthetic sentiment, and laughed for a moment again.

2.17.s: bhuktavantau ca tāmbūlaṃ pradataṃ ca parasparam .. 87 ..
2.17.d: भुक्तवन्तौ च ताम्बूलं प्रदतं च परस्परम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.17.m: They chewed the betel that they had offered to each other;

2.17.s:
parasparaṃ sevitau ca suprītyā śvetacāmaraiḥ ..
kṣaṇaṃ śayānau sānandau vasantau ca kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ .. 88 ..
2.17.d:
परस्परं सेवितौ च सुप्रीत्या श्वेतचामरैः ॥
क्षणं शयानौ सानन्दौ वसन्तौ च क्षणं पुनः ॥ 88 ॥
2.17.m:
with great affection they fanned each other with white chowries.
For a moment lying down joyfully, and for a moment sitting up again;

2.17.s:
kṣaṇaṃ keliniyuktau ca rasabhāvasamanvitau ..
suratādviratirnāsti tau tadviṣayapaṇḍitau .. 89 ..
2.17.d:
क्षणं केलिनियुक्तौ च रसभावसमन्वितौ ॥
सुरताद्विरतिर्नास्ति तौ तद्विषयपण्डितौ ॥ 89 ॥
2.17.m:
for a moment engaged in amorous play, full of romantic sentiment and emotion.
There was no cessation from intercourse; both were skilled in that art.

2.17.s: satataṃ jayayuktau dvau kṣaṇaṃ naiva parājitau .. .. 2.17.90 ..
2.17.d: सततं जययुक्तौ द्वौ क्षणं नैव पराजितौ ॥ ॥ 2.17.90 ॥
2.17.m: Both were constantly victorious, and neither was ever defeated for a single moment.

2.18.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā dhyātvā rājā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ..
brāhme muhūrtte cotthāya puṣpatalpānmanoharāt ..1..
2.18.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
श्रीकृष्णं मनसा ध्यात्वा राजा कृष्णपरायणः ॥
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्ते चोत्थाय पुष्पतल्पान्मनोहरात् ॥1॥

2.18.s:
rātrivāsaḥ parityajya snātvā maṅgalavāriṇā ..
dhaute ca vāsasī dhṛtvā kṛtvā tilakamujjvalam ..2..
2.18.d:
रात्रिवासः परित्यज्य स्नात्वा मङ्गलवारिणा ॥
धौते च वाससी धृत्वा कृत्वा तिलकमुज्ज्वलम् ॥2॥

2.18.s:
cakārāhnikamāvaśyamabhīṣṭaguruvandanam ..
dadhyājyaṃ madhu lājāṃśca so'paśyadvastu maṅgalam .. 3 ..
2.18.d:
चकाराह्निकमावश्यमभीष्टगुरुवन्दनम् ॥
दध्याज्यं मधु लाजांश्च सोऽपश्यद्वस्तु मङ्गलम् ॥ 3 ॥

2.18.s:
ratnaśreṣṭhaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ vastraśreṣṭhaṃ ca kāñcanam ..
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau bhaktyā yathānityaṃ ca nārada .. 4 ..
2.18.d:
रत्नश्रेष्ठं मणिश्रेष्ठं वस्त्रश्रेष्ठं च काञ्चनम् ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ भक्त्या यथानित्यं च नारद ॥ 4 ॥

2.18.s:
amūlyaratnaṃ yatkiñcinmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam ..
dadau viprāya gurave yātrāmaṅgalahetave .. 5 ..
2.18.d:
अमूल्यरत्नं यत्किञ्चिन्मुक्तामाणिक्यहीरकम् ॥
ददौ विप्राय गुरवे यात्रामङ्गलहेतवे ॥ 5 ॥

2.18.s:
gajaratnaṃ cāśvaratnaṃ dhenuratnaṃ manoharam ..
dadau sarvaṃ daridrāya viprārthaṃ maṅgalāya ca .. 6 ..
2.18.d:
गजरत्नं चाश्वरत्नं धेनुरत्नं मनोहरम् ॥
ददौ सर्वं दरिद्राय विप्रार्थं मङ्गलाय च ॥ 6 ॥

2.18.s:
kośāgārasahasraṃ ca nagarāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ..
grāmāṇāṃ śatakoṭiṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 7 ..
2.18.d:
कोशागारसहस्रं च नगराणां त्रिलक्षकम् ॥
ग्रामाणां शतकोटिं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 7 ॥

2.18.s:
putraṃ kṛtvā ca rājendraṃ sucandraṃ dānaveṣu ca ..
putre samarpya bhāryāṃ ca rājyaṃ vai sarvasampadam .. 8 ..
2.18.d:
पुत्रं कृत्वा च राजेन्द्रं सुचन्द्रं दानवेषु च ॥
पुत्रे समर्प्य भार्यां च राज्यं वै सर्वसम्पदम् ॥ 8 ॥

2.18.s:
prajānucarasaṃghaṃ ca kośaughaṃ vāhanādikam ..
svayaṃ sannāhayuktaśca dhanuṣpāṇirbabhūva ha .. 9 ..
2.18.d:
प्रजानुचरसंघं च कोशौघं वाहनादिकम् ॥
स्वयं सन्नाहयुक्तश्च धनुष्पाणिर्बभूव ह ॥ 9 ॥

2.18.s:
bhṛtyadvārā krameṇaiva sa cakre sainyasaṃcayam ..
aśvānāṃ ca trilakṣeṇa pañcalakṣeṇa hastinām .. .. 2.18.10 ..
2.18.d:
भृत्यद्वारा क्रमेणैव स चक्रे सैन्यसंचयम् ॥
अश्वानां च त्रिलक्षेण पञ्चलक्षेण हस्तिनाम् ॥ ॥ 2.18.10 ॥

2.18.s:
rathānāmayutenaiva dhānuṣkāṇāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ..
trikoṭibhiścarmiṇāṃ ca śūlināṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ .. 11 ..
2.18.d:
रथानामयुतेनैव धानुष्काणां त्रिकोटिभिः ॥
त्रिकोटिभिश्चर्मिणां च शूलिनां च त्रिकोटिभिः ॥ 11 ॥

2.18.s:
kṛtā senā'parimitā dānavendreṇa nārada ..
yasyāṃ senāpatiścaiva yuddhaśāstraviśāradaḥ .. 12 ..
2.18.d:
कृता सेनाऽपरिमिता दानवेन्द्रेण नारद ॥
यस्यां सेनापतिश्चैव युद्धशास्त्रविशारदः ॥ 12 ॥

2.18.s:
mahārathaḥ sa vijñeyo rathināṃ pravaro raṇe ..
trilakṣākṣauhiṇī senāpatiṃ kṛtvā narādhipaḥ..13..
2.18.d:
महारथः स विज्ञेयो रथिनां प्रवरो रणे ॥
त्रिलक्षाक्षौहिणी सेनापतिं कृत्वा नराधिपः॥13॥

2.18.s:
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīvādyabhāṇḍaughaṃ ca cakāra saḥ ..
bahirbabhūva śibirānmanasā śrīhariṃ smaran..14..
2.18.d:
त्रिंशदक्षौहिणीवाद्यभाण्डौघं च चकार सः ॥
बहिर्बभूव शिबिरान्मनसा श्रीहरिं स्मरन्॥14॥

2.18.s:
ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ vimānaṃ hyāruroha saḥ ..
guruvargānpuraskṛtya prayayau śaṅkarāntikam .. 15 ..
2.18.d:
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचितं विमानं ह्यारुरोह सः ॥
गुरुवर्गान्पुरस्कृत्य प्रययौ शङ्करान्तिकम् ॥ 15 ॥

2.18.s:
puṣpabhadrānadītīre yatrākṣayavaṭaḥ śubhaḥ ..
siddhāśramaṃ ca siddhānāṃ siddhikṣetraṃ ca nāmataḥ ..16..
2.18.d:
पुष्पभद्रानदीतीरे यत्राक्षयवटः शुभः ॥
सिद्धाश्रमं च सिद्धानां सिद्धिक्षेत्रं च नामतः ॥16॥

2.18.s:
kapilasya tapasthānaṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhārate ..
paścimodadhipūrve ca malayasya ca paścime..17..
2.18.d:
कपिलस्य तपस्थानं पुण्यक्षेत्रं च भारते ॥
पश्चिमोदधिपूर्वे च मलयस्य च पश्चिमे॥17॥

2.18.s:
śrīśailottarabhāge ca gandhamādanadakṣiṇe ..
pañcayojanavistīrṇā dairghye śataguṇā tathā ..
śāśvatī jalapūrṇā ca puṣpabhadrānadī śubhā .. 18 ..
2.18.d:
श्रीशैलोत्तरभागे च गन्धमादनदक्षिणे ॥
पञ्चयोजनविस्तीर्णा दैर्घ्ये शतगुणा तथा ॥
शाश्वती जलपूर्णा च पुष्पभद्रानदी शुभा ॥ 18 ॥

2.18.s:
lavaṇodapriyā bhāryyā śaśvatsaubhāgyasaṃyutā ..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā bhārate ca supuṇyadā ..19..
2.18.d:
लवणोदप्रिया भार्य्या शश्वत्सौभाग्यसंयुता ॥
शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशा भारते च सुपुण्यदा ॥19॥

2.18.s:
śarāvatīmiśritā ca nirgatā sā himālayāt..
gomantaṃ vāmataḥ kṛtvā praviṣṭā paścimodadhau ..2.18.20..
2.18.d:
शरावतीमिश्रिता च निर्गता सा हिमालयात्॥
गोमन्तं वामतः कृत्वा प्रविष्टा पश्चिमोदधौ ॥2.18.20॥

2.18.s:
tatra gatvā śaṃkhacūḍo luloke candraśekharam ..
vaṭamūle samāsīnaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham .. 21 ..
2.18.d:
तत्र गत्वा शंखचूडो लुलोके चन्द्रशेखरम् ॥
वटमूले समासीनं सूर्य्यकोटिसमप्रभम् ॥ 21 ॥

2.18.s:
kṛtvā yogāsane sthitvā mudrāyuktaṃ ca sasmitam ..
śuddhasphaṭika saṅkāśaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā .. 22 ..
2.18.d:
कृत्वा योगासने स्थित्वा मुद्रायुक्तं च सस्मितम् ॥
शुद्धस्फटिक सङ्काशं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 22 ॥

2.18.s:
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam ..
taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ jaṭājālaṃ ca bibhratam .. 23 ..
2.18.d:
त्रिशूलपट्टिशधरं व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरं वरम् ॥
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभं जटाजालं च बिभ्रतम् ॥ 23 ॥

2.18.s:
trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca nāgayajñopavītinam ..
mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālamṛtyuṃ viśvamṛtyukaraṃ param .. 24 ..
2.18.d:
त्रिनेत्रं पञ्चवक्त्रं च नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥
मृत्युञ्जयं कालमृत्युं विश्वमृत्युकरं परम् ॥ 24 ॥

2.18.s:
bhaktamṛtyuharaṃ śāntaṃ gaurīkāntaṃ manoramam ..
tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām .. 25 ..
2.18.d:
भक्तमृत्युहरं शान्तं गौरीकान्तं मनोरमम् ॥
तपसां फलदातारं दातारं सर्वसम्पदाम् ॥ 25 ॥

2.18.s:
āśutoṣaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ..
viśvanāthaṃ viśvarūpaṃ viśvabījaṃ ca viśvajam .. 26 ..
2.18.d:
आशुतोषं प्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ॥
विश्वनाथं विश्वरूपं विश्वबीजं च विश्वजम् ॥ 26 ॥

2.18.s:
viśvambharaṃ viśvavaraṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam ..
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca narakārṇavatāraṇam .. 27 ..
2.18.d:
विश्वम्भरं विश्ववरं विश्वसंहारकारणम् ॥
कारणं कारणानां च नरकार्णवतारणम् ॥ 27 ॥

2.18.s:
jñānapradaṃ jñānabījaṃ jñānānandaṃ sanātanam ..
avaruhya vimānācca sa dṛṣṭvā dānaveśvaraḥ .. 28 ..
2.18.d:
ज्ञानप्रदं ज्ञानबीजं ज्ञानानन्दं सनातनम् ॥
अवरुह्य विमानाच्च स दृष्ट्वा दानवेश्वरः ॥ 28 ॥

2.18.s:
sarvaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhaktiyuktaḥ śirasā praṇanāma saḥ ..
vāmato bhadrakālīṃ ca skandaṃ tatpurataḥ sthitam .. 29 ..
2.18.d:
सर्वैः सार्द्धं भक्तियुक्तः शिरसा प्रणनाम सः ॥
वामतो भद्रकालीं च स्कन्दं तत्पुरतः स्थितम् ॥ 29 ॥

2.18.s:
āśiṣaṃ ca dadau tasmai kālī skandaśca śaṅkaraḥ ..
uttasthurdānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ..2.18.30..
2.18.d:
आशिषं च ददौ तस्मै काली स्कन्दश्च शङ्करः ॥
उत्तस्थुर्दानवं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे नन्दीश्वरादयः ॥2.18.30॥

2.18.s:
parasparaṃ ca sambhāṣāṃ te cakustatra sāmpratam..
rājā kṛtvā ca sambhāṣāmuvāsa śivasannidhau ..31..
2.18.d:
परस्परं च सम्भाषां ते चकुस्तत्र साम्प्रतम्॥
राजा कृत्वा च सम्भाषामुवास शिवसन्निधौ ॥31॥

2.18.s: prasannātmā mahādevo bhagavāṃstamuvāca ha .. 32 ..
2.18.d: प्रसन्नात्मा महादेवो भगवांस्तमुवाच ह ॥ 32 ॥

2.18.s:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
vidhātā jagatāṃ brahmā pitā dharmasya dharmavit ..
marīcistasya putraśca vaiṣṇavaścāpi dhārmikaḥ .. 33 ..
2.18.d:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ॥
विधाता जगतां ब्रह्मा पिता धर्मस्य धर्मवित् ॥
मरीचिस्तस्य पुत्रश्च वैष्णवश्चापि धार्मिकः ॥ 33 ॥

2.18.s:
kaśyapaścāpi tatputro dharmiṣṭhaśca prajāpatiḥ ..
dakṣaḥ prītyā dadau tasmai bhaktyā kanyāstrayodaśa .. 34 ..
2.18.d:
कश्यपश्चापि तत्पुत्रो धर्मिष्ठश्च प्रजापतिः ॥
दक्षः प्रीत्या ददौ तस्मै भक्त्या कन्यास्त्रयोदश ॥ 34 ॥

2.18.s:
tāsvekā ca danuḥ sādhvī tatsaubhāgyena varddhitā ..
catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrā dānavāstejasojjvalāḥ .. 35 ..
2.18.d:
तास्वेका च दनुः साध्वी तत्सौभाग्येन वर्द्धिता ॥
चत्वारिंशद्दनोः पुत्रा दानवास्तेजसोज्ज्वलाः ॥ 35 ॥

2.18.s:
teṣveko vipracittiśca mahābalaparākramaḥ ..
tatputro dhārmiko dambho viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ .. 36 ..
2.18.d:
तेष्वेको विप्रचित्तिश्च महाबलपराक्रमः ॥
तत्पुत्रो धार्मिको दम्भो विष्णुभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 36 ॥

2.18.s:
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ puṣkare lakṣavatsaram ..
śukācāryyaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 37 ..
2.18.d:
जजाप परमं मन्त्रं पुष्करे लक्षवत्सरम् ॥
शुकाचार्य्यं गुरुं कृत्वा कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 37 ॥

2.18.s:
tadā tvāṃ tanayaṃ prāpa paraṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam ..
purā tvaṃ pārṣado gopo gopeṣvaṣṭasu dhārmikaḥ .. 38 ..
2.18.d:
तदा त्वां तनयं प्राप परं कृष्णपरायणम् ॥
पुरा त्वं पार्षदो गोपो गोपेष्वष्टसु धार्मिकः ॥ 38 ॥

2.18.s:
adhunā rādhikāśāpādbhārate dānaveśvaraḥ ..
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ bhramaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 39 ..
2.18.d:
अधुना राधिकाशापाद्भारते दानवेश्वरः ॥
आब्रह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं भ्रमं मेने च वैष्णवः ॥ 39 ॥

2.18.s:
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikyaṃ harerapi ..
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sevanaṃ vinā..2.18.40..
2.18.d:
सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसारूप्यसामीप्यैक्यं हरेरपि ॥
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति वैष्णवाः सेवनं विना॥2.18.40॥

2.18.s:
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tucchaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ..
indratvaṃ vā kuberatvaṃ na mene gaṇanāsu ca .. 41 ..
2.18.d:
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा तुच्छं मेने च वैष्णवः ॥
इन्द्रत्वं वा कुबेरत्वं न मेने गणनासु च ॥ 41 ॥

2.18.s:
kṛṣṇabhaktasya te kiṃ vā devānāṃ viṣaye bhrame ..
dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ matprītiṃ kuru bhūmipa .. 42 ..
2.18.d:
कृष्णभक्तस्य ते किं वा देवानां विषये भ्रमे ॥
देहि राज्यं च देवानां मत्प्रीतिं कुरु भूमिप ॥ 42 ॥
2.18.m:
For you, a devotee of Kṛṣṇa, what delusion is there regarding the realm of the gods?
Return the kingdom to the gods, and give me pleasure, O king. (42)

2.18.s:
sukhaṃ svarājye tvaṃ tiṣṭha devāssantu svake pade ..
alaṃ bhrātṛvirodhena sarve kaśyapavaṃśajāḥ .. 43 ..
2.18.d:
सुखं स्वराज्ये त्वं तिष्ठ देवास्सन्तु स्वके पदे ॥
अलं भ्रातृविरोधेन सर्वे कश्यपवंशजाः ॥ 43 ॥
2.18.m:
Remain happily in your own kingdom; let the gods abide in their own stations.
Enough of enmity between brothers! All are born from Kaśyapa's lineage. (43)

2.18.s:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
jñātidrohasya pāpasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 44 ..
2.18.d:
यानि कानि च पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ॥
ज्ञातिद्रोहस्य पापस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥ 44 ॥
2.18.m: do not equal a sixteenth part of the sin of treachery toward one's kin. (44)

2.18.s:
svasampadāṃ ca hāniṃ ca yadi rājendra manyase ..
sarvāvasthāsu samatā keṣāṃ yāti ca sarvadā..45..
2.18.d:
स्वसम्पदां च हानिं च यदि राजेन्द्र मन्यसे ॥
सर्वावस्थासु समता केषां याति च सर्वदा॥45॥
2.18.m:
And if you consider [this] a loss of your own wealth, O king of kings,
for whom does constancy always endure throughout all conditions? (45)

2.18.s:
brahmaṇaśca tirobhāvo laye prākṛtike sati ..
āvirbhāvaḥ punastasya prabhavedīśvarecchayā.. .. 46 ..
2.18.d:
ब्रह्मणश्च तिरोभावो लये प्राकृतिके सति ॥
आविर्भावः पुनस्तस्य प्रभवेदीश्वरेच्छया॥ ॥ 46 ॥
2.18.m:
Even Brahmā undergoes disappearance when the cosmic dissolution occurs;
and his appearance arises again only by the will of the Supreme Lord. (46)

2.18.s:
jñānaṃ buddhiśca tapasā smṛtirlokasya niścitam ..
karoti sṛṣṭiṃ jñānena sraṣṭā so'pi krameṇa ca ..47..
2.18.d:
ज्ञानं बुद्धिश्च तपसा स्मृतिर्लोकस्य निश्चितम् ॥
करोति सृष्टिं ज्ञानेन स्रष्टा सोऽपि क्रमेण च ॥47॥
2.18.m:
Knowledge, intellect, and certainly the memory of the world [arise] through austerity;
and with knowledge that creator also brings forth creation in due order. (47)

2.18.s:
paripūrṇatamo dharmaḥ satye satyāśrayaḥ sadā ..
so'pi tribhāgastretāyāṃ dvibhāgo dvāpare smṛtaḥ .. 48 ..
2.18.d:
परिपूर्णतमो धर्मः सत्ये सत्याश्रयः सदा ॥
सोऽपि त्रिभागस्त्रेतायां द्विभागो द्वापरे स्मृतः ॥ 48 ॥
2.18.m:
Dharma is most complete in the Satya [age], always resting on truth;
it is remembered as three parts in Tretā, and two parts in Dvāpara. (48)

2.18.s:
ekabhāgaḥ kaleḥ pūrve taddhrāsaśca krameṇa ca ..
kalāmātraṃ kaleḥ śeṣe kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā .. 49 ..
2.18.d:
एकभागः कलेः पूर्वे तद्ध्रासश्च क्रमेण च ॥
कलामात्रं कलेः शेषे कुह्वां चन्द्रकला यथा ॥ 49 ॥
2.18.m:
It is one part at the beginning of Kali, and gradually suffers decline,
until only a single digit [remains] at the end of Kali, like the digit of the moon on the new moon night. (49)

2.18.s:
yādṛktejo ravergrīṣme na tādṛkśiśire punaḥ ..
dine ca yādṛṅ madhyāhne sāyaṃprātarna tatsamam .. 2.18.50 ..
2.18.d:
यादृक्तेजो रवेर्ग्रीष्मे न तादृक्शिशिरे पुनः ॥
दिने च यादृङ् मध्याह्ने सायंप्रातर्न तत्समम् ॥ 2.18.50 ॥
2.18.m:
Such splendour as the sun has in summer is not the same in winter;
and what it has at midday is not equalled at evening or at dawn. (50)

2.18.s:
udayaṃ yāti kālena bālyatāṃ ca krameṇa ca ..
prakāṇḍatāṃ ca tatpaścātkāle'staṃ punareva saḥ .. 51 ..
2.18.d:
उदयं याति कालेन बाल्यतां च क्रमेण च ॥
प्रकाण्डतां च तत्पश्चात्कालेऽस्तं पुनरेव सः ॥ 51 ॥
2.18.m:
It attains rising in time, and childhood in due course,
and full maturity thereafter; and then, in time, it sets once more. (51)

2.18.s:
dine pracchannatāṃ yāti kāle vai durdine ghane ..
rāhugraste kampitaśca punareva prasannatām .. 52 ..
2.18.d:
दिने प्रच्छन्नतां याति काले वै दुर्दिने घने ॥
राहुग्रस्ते कम्पितश्च पुनरेव प्रसन्नताम् ॥ 52 ॥
2.18.m:
It becomes concealed by day when time brings thick, foul weather;
and swallowed by Rāhu, it trembles, yet again attains clarity. (52)

2.18.s:
paripūrṇatamaścandraḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yādṛśaḥ.. .
tādṛśo na bhavennityaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine ..53..
2.18.d:
परिपूर्णतमश्चन्द्रः पूर्णिमायां च यादृशः॥ ।
तादृशो न भवेन्नित्यं क्षयं याति दिनेदिने ॥53॥
2.18.m: Just as the moon is most complete on the full moon night, / it cannot remain so constantly, but wanes day by day. (53)

2.18.s:
punaḥ sa puṣṭatāṃ yāti parakuhvā dinedine ..
sampadyuktaḥ śuklapakṣe kṛṣṇe mlānaśca yakṣmaṇā .. 54 ..
2.18.d:
पुनः स पुष्टतां याति परकुह्वा दिनेदिने ॥
सम्पद्युक्तः शुक्लपक्षे कृष्णे म्लानश्च यक्ष्मणा ॥ 54 ॥
2.18.m:
Again it attains fullness day by day after the new moon;
endowed with prosperity in the bright fortnight, and faded by consumption in the dark fortnight. (54)

2.18.s:
rāhugraste dine mlāno durdine nibiḍe ghane ..
kāle candro bhavecchuddho bhraṣṭaśrīḥ kālabhedake .. 55 ..
2.18.d:
राहुग्रस्ते दिने म्लानो दुर्दिने निबिडे घने ॥
काले चन्द्रो भवेच्छुद्धो भ्रष्टश्रीः कालभेदके ॥ 55 ॥
2.18.m:
Faded by day when seized by Rāhu, or in thick, heavy foul weather;
in time the moon becomes pure, and at a shift of time its splendour is lost. (55)

2.18.s:
bhaviṣyati baliścendro bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sutale'dhunā ..
kālena pṛthvī sasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā .. 56 ..
2.18.d:
भविष्यति बलिश्चेन्द्रो भ्रष्टश्रीः सुतलेऽधुना ॥
कालेन पृथ्वी सस्याढ्या सर्वाधारा वसुन्धरा ॥ 56 ॥
2.18.m:
Bali, who will be Indra, is now stripped of fortune in Sutala.
In time the earth is rich with crops, the bearer of wealth that supports all; (56)

2.18.s:
kāle jale nimagnā sā tirobhūtā vipadgatā ..
kāle naśyanti viśvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ .. 97 ..
2.18.d:
काले जले निमग्ना सा तिरोभूता विपद्गता ॥
काले नश्यन्ति विश्वानि प्रभवन्त्येव कालतः ॥ 97 ॥
2.18.m:
in time she is submerged in the waters, vanished, fallen into calamity.
In time the universes perish, and by time alone they arise. (57)

2.18.s:
carācarāśca kālena naśyanti prabhavanti ca ..
īśvarasyaiva samatā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 58 ..
2.18.d:
चराचराश्च कालेन नश्यन्ति प्रभवन्ति च ॥
ईश्वरस्यैव समता कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 58 ॥
2.18.m:
The moving and unmoving things perish and arise through time;
only the Supreme Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, has constancy. (58)

2.18.s:
ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo yasmādasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam ..
adṛśyaṃ cāpi paśyāmi vāraṃ vāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ .. .. 59 ..
2.18.d:
अहं मृत्युञ्जयो यस्मादसंख्यं प्राकृतं लयम् ॥
अदृश्यं चापि पश्यामि वारं वारं पुनः पुनः ॥ ॥ 59 ॥
2.18.m:
I am the conqueror of death because countless cosmic dissolutions,
invisible [to others], I witness time and time again. (59)

2.18.s:
sa ca prakṛtirūpaśca sa eva puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sa cātmā sarvajīvaśca nānārūpadharaḥ paraḥ .. 2.18.60 ..
2.18.d:
स च प्रकृतिरूपश्च स एव पुरुषः स्मृतः ॥
स चात्मा सर्वजीवश्च नानारूपधरः परः ॥ 2.18.60 ॥
2.18.m:
He is the embodiment of Prakṛti, and he is remembered as Puruṣa;
and he is the Self, every living being, the Supreme who assumes manifold forms. (60)

2.18.s:
karoti satataṃ yo hi tannāmaguṇakīrttanam ..
kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ sa jayati janma rogaṃ jarāṃ bhayam .. 61 ..
2.18.d:
करोति सततं यो हि तन्नामगुणकीर्त्तनम् ॥
कालं मृत्युं स जयति जन्म रोगं जरां भयम् ॥ 61 ॥
2.18.m:
Whoever constantly engages in chanting the praises of his names and qualities
conquers time, death, birth, disease, old age, and fear. (61)

2.18.s:
sraṣṭā kṛto vidhistena pātā viṣṇuḥ kṛto bhave ..
ahaṃ kṛtaśca saṃharttā vayaṃ viṣayiṇo yataḥ ..62..
2.18.d:
स्रष्टा कृतो विधिस्तेन पाता विष्णुः कृतो भवे ॥
अहं कृतश्च संहर्त्ता वयं विषयिणो यतः ॥62॥
2.18.m:
By him Brahmā was made creator, and Viṣṇu was made protector in the world;
and I was made destroyer, since we are involved with active affairs. (62)

2.18.s:
kālāgnirudraṃ saṃhāre niyujya viṣaye nṛpa ..
ahaṃ karomi satataṃ tannāmaguṇakīrttanam .. .. 63 ..
2.18.d:
कालाग्निरुद्रं संहारे नियुज्य विषये नृप ॥
अहं करोमि सततं तन्नामगुणकीर्त्तनम् ॥ ॥ 63 ॥
2.18.m:
Having appointed the Kālāgnirudra in the affair of destruction, O king,
I constantly chant the praises of his names and qualities. (63)

2.18.s:
tena mṛtyuñjayo'haṃ ca jñānenānena nirbhayaḥ ..
mṛtyurmatto bhayādyāti vainateyādivoragaḥ .. 64 ..
2.18.d:
तेन मृत्युञ्जयोऽहं च ज्ञानेनानेन निर्भयः ॥
मृत्युर्मत्तो भयाद्याति वैनतेयादिवोरगः ॥ 64 ॥
2.18.m:
Therefore, through this knowledge, I have conquered death and am free from fear;
death flees from me in terror, like a snake from the son of Vinatā. (64)

2.18.s:
ityuktvā sa ca sarveśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ..
virarāmātha śarvaśca sabhāmadhye ca nārada .. 69 ..
2.18.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स च सर्वेशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वभावनः ॥
विररामाथ शर्वश्च सभामध्ये च नारद ॥ 69 ॥
2.18.m:
Having spoken thus, that lord of all, all-knowing, the author of all beings,
Śarva then ceased in the midst of the assembly, O Nārada. (65)

2.18.s:
rājā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ ..
uvāca suṃdaraṃ devaṃ paraṃ vinayapūrvakam .. 66 ..
2.18.d:
राजा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रशशंस पुनः पुनः ॥
उवाच सुंदरं देवं परं विनयपूर्वकम् ॥ 66 ॥
2.18.m:
Having heard his speech, the king praised it again and again,
and spoke to the handsome god with utmost humility. (66)

2.18.s:
śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca ..
tvayā yatkathitaṃ nātha sarvaṃ satyaṃ ca nānṛtam ..
tathā'pi kiñcidyatsatyaṃ śrūyatāṃ mannivedanam .. 67 ..
2.18.d:
शंखचूड उवाच ॥
त्वया यत्कथितं नाथ सर्वं सत्यं च नानृतम् ॥
तथाऽपि किञ्चिद्यत्सत्यं श्रूयतां मन्निवेदनम् ॥ 67 ॥
2.18.m:
All that was spoken by you, O master, is true and not false;
nevertheless, hear my submission, whatever truth there is in it. (67)

2.18.s:
jñātidrohe mahatpāpaṃ tvayoktamadhunā trayam ..
gṛhītvā tasya sarvasvaṃ kutaḥ prasthāpito baliḥ .. 68 ..
2.18.d:
ज्ञातिद्रोहे महत्पापं त्वयोक्तमधुना त्रयम् ॥
गृहीत्वा तस्य सर्वस्वं कुतः प्रस्थापितो बलिः ॥ 68 ॥
2.18.m:
Just now you proclaimed that there is great sin in treachery toward kin;
why was Bali banished after having seized all that was his? (68)

2.18.s:
mayā samuddhṛtaṃ sarvamaiśvaryyaṃ vikrameṇa ca ..
sutalācca samuddhartuṃ nālaṃ so'pi gadādharaḥ ..69 ..
2.18.d:
मया समुद्धृतं सर्वमैश्वर्य्यं विक्रमेण च ॥
सुतलाच्च समुद्धर्तुं नालं सोऽपि गदाधरः ॥69 ॥
2.18.m:
All this sovereignty was won by me through valour;
even that wielder of the mace is unable to deliver it from Sutala. (69)

2.18.s:
sabhrātṛko hiraṇyākṣaḥ kathaṃ devaiśca hiṃsitaḥ ..
śumbhādayaścāsurā vai kathaṃ devairnipātitāḥ .. 2.18.70 ..
2.18.d:
सभ्रातृको हिरण्याक्षः कथं देवैश्च हिंसितः ॥
शुम्भादयश्चासुरा वै कथं देवैर्निपातिताः ॥ 2.18.70 ॥
2.18.m:
Why was Hiraṇyākṣa along with his brother destroyed by the gods?
And how were the asuras such as Śumbha struck down by the gods? (70)

2.18.s:
purā samudramathane pīyūṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ suraiḥ ..
kleśabhājo vayaṃ tatra taiḥ sarvaphalabhājanaiḥ.. .. 71 ..
2.18.d:
पुरा समुद्रमथने पीयूषं भक्षितं सुरैः ॥
क्लेशभाजो वयं तत्र तैः सर्वफलभाजनैः॥ ॥ 71 ॥
2.18.m:
Long ago, at the churning of the ocean, the nectar was consumed by the gods;
we endured the hardship there, while they enjoyed all the fruits. // 71

2.18.s:
krīḍābhāṇḍamidaṃ viśvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
yadā dadāti yasmai sa tasyaiśvaryaṃ bhavettadā .. 72 ..
2.18.d:
क्रीडाभाण्डमिदं विश्वं कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥
यदा ददाति यस्मै स तस्यैश्वर्यं भवेत्तदा ॥ 72 ॥
2.18.m:
This universe is a plaything of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman;
when he gives [it] to whomsoever, dominion belongs to that one at that time. // 72

2.18.s:
devadānavayorvādaḥ śaśvannaimittikaḥ sadā ..
parājayo jayasteṣāṃ kāle'smākaṃ krameṇa ca .. 73 ..
2.18.d:
देवदानवयोर्वादः शश्वन्नैमित्तिकः सदा ॥
पराजयो जयस्तेषां कालेऽस्माकं क्रमेण च ॥ 73 ॥
2.18.m:
The dispute between gods and Dānavas is perpetual, constant, and occasioned [by time];
defeat and victory belong to them and to us in due course through time. // 73

2.18.s:
tatrāvayorvirodhe ca gamanaṃ niṣphalaṃ tava ..
sama sambandhinorbandhvorīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 74 ..
2.18.d:
तत्रावयोर्विरोधे च गमनं निष्फलं तव ॥
सम सम्बन्धिनोर्बन्ध्वोरीश्वरस्य महात्मनः ॥ 74 ॥
2.18.m:
Therefore, in our dispute, your intervention is fruitless,
for an impartial Lord, a high-souled relative and kinsman of both sides. // 74

2.18.s:
jāyate mahatī lajjā sparddhā'smābhiḥ sahādhunā ..
tato'dhikā ca samare kīrtti hāniḥ parājaye .. 75 ..
2.18.d:
जायते महती लज्जा स्पर्द्धाऽस्माभिः सहाधुना ॥
ततोऽधिका च समरे कीर्त्ति हानिः पराजये ॥ 75 ॥
2.18.m:
Great shame arises now from rivalry with us,
and even greater loss of fame in battle upon defeat." // 75

2.18.s:
śaṃkhacūḍavacaḥ śrutvā prahasyāha trilocanaḥ ..
yathocitaṃ sumadhuramatyugraṃ dānaveśvaram .. 76 ..
2.18.d:
शंखचूडवचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्याह त्रिलोचनः ॥
यथोचितं सुमधुरमत्युग्रं दानवेश्वरम् ॥ 76 ॥
2.18.m:
Hearing Śaṅkhacūḍa's words, the Three-eyed Lord laughed and said
to the extremely fierce lord of Dānavas what was fitting and very sweet: // 76

2.18.s:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
yuṣmābhiḥ saha yuddhaṃ me brahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ ..
kā lajjā mahatī rājannakīrtirvā parājaye .. 77 ..
2.18.d:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ॥
युष्माभिः सह युद्धं मे ब्रह्मवंशसमुद्भवैः ॥
का लज्जा महती राजन्नकीर्तिर्वा पराजये ॥ 77 ॥
2.18.m:
"For me to battle with you who are born of the lineage of Brahmā—
what great shame can there be, O king, or what infamy in defeat? // 77

2.18.s:
yuddhamādau harereva madhunā kaiṭabhena ca ..
hiraṇyakaśipoścaiva saha tenātmanā nṛpa .. 78 ..
2.18.d:
युद्धमादौ हरेरेव मधुना कैटभेन च ॥
हिरण्यकशिपोश्चैव सह तेनात्मना नृप ॥ 78 ॥
2.18.m:
In the beginning, Hari himself fought with Madhu and Kaiṭabha,
and indeed with Hiraṇyakaśipu himself, O king; // 78

2.18.s:
hiraṇyākṣasya yuddhaṃ ca punastena gadābhṛtā ..
tripuraiḥ saha yuddhaṃ ca mayā cāpi purā kṛtam .. 79 ..
2.18.d:
हिरण्याक्षस्य युद्धं च पुनस्तेन गदाभृता ॥
त्रिपुरैः सह युद्धं च मया चापि पुरा कृतम् ॥ 79 ॥
2.18.m:
and with Hiraṇyākṣa there was battle again by that wielder of the mace;
and battle with the Tripuras was also waged by me in the past. // 79

2.18.s:
sarveśvaryyāḥ sarvamātuḥ prakṛtyāśca babhūva ha ..
saha śumbhādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ samaraṃ paramādbhutam .. 2.18.80 ..
2.18.d:
सर्वेश्वर्य्याः सर्वमातुः प्रकृत्याश्च बभूव ह ॥
सह शुम्भादिभिः पूर्वं समरं परमाद्भुतम् ॥ 2.18.80 ॥
2.18.m:
And of Prakṛti, the sovereign of all and mother of all,
there was formerly a most wonderful battle with Śumbha and the others. // 80

2.18.s:
pārṣadapravarastvaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ..
ye ye hatāśca te daityā nahi ke'pi tvayā samāḥ.. 81 ..
2.18.d:
पार्षदप्रवरस्त्वं च कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥
ये ये हताश्च ते दैत्या नहि केऽपि त्वया समाः॥ 81 ॥
2.18.m:
Moreover, you are an eminent attendant of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman;
whichever Daityas were slain, none of them were equal to you. // 81

2.18.s:
kā lajjā mahatī rājanmama yuddhe tvayā saha ..
surāṇāṃ śaraṇasyaiva preṣitasya hareraho .. 82 ..
2.18.d:
का लज्जा महती राजन्मम युद्धे त्वया सह ॥
सुराणां शरणस्यैव प्रेषितस्य हरेरहो ॥ 82 ॥
2.18.m:
What great shame can there be, O king, in my battling with you,
I who am indeed the refuge of the gods, sent by Hari, oh! // 82

2.18.s:
dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ vāgvyaye kiṃ prayojanam ..
yuddhaṃ mā kuru matsārddhamiti me niścitaṃ vacaḥ .. 83 ..
2.18.d:
देहि राज्यं च देवानां वाग्व्यये किं प्रयोजनम् ॥
युद्धं मा कुरु मत्सार्द्धमिति मे निश्चितं वचः ॥ 83 ॥
2.18.m:
Give the kingdom back to the gods; what is the use of wasting words?
Do not wage war against me—this is my settled word." // 83

2.18.s:
ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra virarāma ca nārada ..
uttasthau śaṃkhacūḍaśca svāmānyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ .. 84 ..
2.18.d:
इत्युक्त्वा शंकरस्तत्र विरराम च नारद ॥
उत्तस्थौ शंखचूडश्च स्वामान्यैः सह सत्वरः ॥ 84 ॥
2.18.m: and Śaṅkhacūḍa stood up quickly along with his ministers. // 84

2.19.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śivaṃ praṇamya śirasā dānavendraḥ pratāpavān ..
samāruroha yānaṃ ca svāmātyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ .. 1 ..
2.19.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
शिवं प्रणम्य शिरसा दानवेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥
समारुरोह यानं च स्वामात्यैः सह सत्वरः ॥ 1 ॥

2.19.s:
babhūvuste ca saṃkṣubdhāḥ skandaśaktyā'rditāstadā ..
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha .. 2 ..
2.19.d:
बभूवुस्ते च संक्षुब्धाः स्कन्दशक्त्याऽर्दितास्तदा ॥
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह ॥ 2 ॥

2.19.s:
skandasyopari tatraiva samare ca bhayaṅkare ..
skandasya samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadadbhutamulbaṇam .. 3 ..
2.19.d:
स्कन्दस्योपरि तत्रैव समरे च भयङ्करे ॥
स्कन्दस्य समरं दृष्ट्वा महदद्भुतमुल्बणम् ॥ 3 ॥

2.19.s:
dānavānāṃ kṣayakaraṃ yathā prākṛtikaṃ layam ..
rājā vimānamāruhya śaravarṣaṃ cakāra ha .. 4 ..
2.19.d:
दानवानां क्षयकरं यथा प्राकृतिकं लयम् ॥
राजा विमानमारुह्य शरवर्षं चकार ह ॥ 4 ॥

2.19.s:
nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭiśca ghanavṛṣṭiryathā tathā ..
mahānghorāndhakāraśca vahnyutthānaṃ babhūva ha .. 5 ..
2.19.d:
नृपस्य शरवृष्टिश्च घनवृष्टिर्यथा तथा ॥
महान्घोरान्धकारश्च वह्न्युत्थानं बभूव ह ॥ 5 ॥

2.19.s:
devāḥ pradudruvuścānye sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ..
ekākī kārttikeyastu tasthau samaramūrddhani .. 6 ..
2.19.d:
देवाः प्रदुद्रुवुश्चान्ये सर्वे नन्दीश्वरादयः ॥
एकाकी कार्त्तिकेयस्तु तस्थौ समरमूर्द्धनि ॥ 6 ॥

2.19.s:
parvatānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śilānāṃ śākhināṃ tathā ..
śaśvaccakāra vṛṣṭiṃ ca durvāhyāṃ ca bhayaṅkarīm .. 7 ..
2.19.d:
पर्वतानां च सर्पाणां शिलानां शाखिनां तथा ॥
शश्वच्चकार वृष्टिं च दुर्वाह्यां च भयङ्करीम् ॥ 7 ॥

2.19.s:
nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭyā ca pracchannaḥ śivanandanaḥ .
nīradena ca sāndreṇa saṃcchanno bhāskaro yathā ..8..
2.19.d:
नृपस्य शरवृष्ट्या च प्रच्छन्नः शिवनन्दनः ।
नीरदेन च सान्द्रेण संच्छन्नो भास्करो यथा ॥8॥

2.19.s:
dhanusskandasya ciccheda durvahaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ..
babhañja ca rathaṃ divyaṃ ciccheda rathaghoṭakān .. 9 ..
2.19.d:
धनुस्स्कन्दस्य चिच्छेद दुर्वहं च भयङ्करम् ॥
बभञ्ज च रथं दिव्यं चिच्छेद रथघोटकान् ॥ 9 ॥

2.19.s:
mayūraṃ jarjjarībhūtaṃ divyāstreṇa cakāra saḥ ..
śaktiṃ cikṣepa sūryyābhāṃ tasya vakṣovibhedinīm .. 2.19.10 ..
2.19.d:
मयूरं जर्ज्जरीभूतं दिव्यास्त्रेण चकार सः ॥
शक्तिं चिक्षेप सूर्य्याभां तस्य वक्षोविभेदिनीम् ॥ 2.19.10 ॥

2.19.s:
kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāṃ ca saṃprāpya cetanāmupalabhya saḥ ..
gṛhītvā'nyaddhanurdivyaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇunā purā .. 11 ..
2.19.d:
क्षणं मूर्छां च संप्राप्य चेतनामुपलभ्य सः ॥
गृहीत्वाऽन्यद्धनुर्दिव्यं यद्दत्तं विष्णुना पुरा ॥ 11 ॥

2.19.s:
ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ yānamāruhya cāgnibhūḥ ..
śastramastraṃ gṛhītvā ca cakāra raṇamulbaṇam .. 12 ..
2.19.d:
रत्नेन्द्रसारखचितं यानमारुह्य चाग्निभूः ॥
शस्त्रमस्त्रं गृहीत्वा च चकार रणमुल्बणम् ॥ 12 ॥

2.19.s:
sarpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca prastarāṃstathā ..
sarvāṃściccheda kopena divyāstreṇa śivātmajaḥ .. 13 ..
2.19.d:
सर्पांश्च पर्वतांश्चैव वृक्षांश्च प्रस्तरांस्तथा ॥
सर्वांश्चिच्छेद कोपेन दिव्यास्त्रेण शिवात्मजः ॥ 13 ॥

2.19.s:
āgneyaṃ vāruṇāstreṇa vārayāmāsa vai guhaḥ ..
rathaṃ dhanuśca ciccheda śaṃkhacūḍasya līlayā .. 14 ..
2.19.d:
आग्नेयं वारुणास्त्रेण वारयामास वै गुहः ॥
रथं धनुश्च चिच्छेद शंखचूडस्य लीलया ॥ 14 ॥

2.19.s:
savāhaṃ sārathiṃ caiva kirīṭaṃ mukuṭojjvalam ..
cikṣepa śaktimulkābhāṃ dānavendrasya vakṣasi .. 15 ..
2.19.d:
सवाहं सारथिं चैव किरीटं मुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ॥
चिक्षेप शक्तिमुल्काभां दानवेन्द्रस्य वक्षसि ॥ 15 ॥

2.19.s:
mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rājopalabhya vai cetanāṃ punaḥ ..
āruhya vai yānamanyaṃ dhanurjagrāha satvaraḥ .. 16 ..
2.19.d:
मूर्च्छां संप्राप्य राजोपलभ्य वै चेतनां पुनः ॥
आरुह्य वै यानमन्यं धनुर्जग्राह सत्वरः ॥ 16 ॥

2.19.s:
cakāra śarajālaṃ ca māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ ..
guhaṃ cācchādya samare śarajālena nārada .. 17 ..
2.19.d:
चकार शरजालं च मायया मायिनां वरः ॥
गुहं चाच्छाद्य समरे शरजालेन नारद ॥ 17 ॥

2.19.s:
jagrāha śaktimavyarthāṃ śatasūryyasamaprabhām ..
pralayāgniśikhārūpāṃ viṣṇorvai tejasā vṛtām .. 18 ..
2.19.d:
जग्राह शक्तिमव्यर्थां शतसूर्य्यसमप्रभाम् ॥
प्रलयाग्निशिखारूपां विष्णोर्वै तेजसा वृताम् ॥ 18 ॥

2.19.s:
cikṣepa tāṃ ca kopena mahāvegena kārttike ..
papāta śaktistadgātre vahnirāśirivojjvalā .. 19 ..
2.19.d:
चिक्षेप तां च कोपेन महावेगेन कार्त्तिके ॥
पपात शक्तिस्तद्गात्रे वह्निराशिरिवोज्ज्वला ॥ 19 ॥

2.19.s:
mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa śaktyā ca kārttikeyo mahābalaḥ ..
kālī gṛhītvā taṃ kroḍe nināya śivasannidhau .. 2.19.20 ..
2.19.d:
मूर्च्छां संप्राप शक्त्या च कार्त्तिकेयो महाबलः ॥
काली गृहीत्वा तं क्रोडे निनाय शिवसन्निधौ ॥ 2.19.20 ॥

2.19.s:
śivastaṃ darśanādeva jīvayāmāsa līlayā ..
dadau balamanantaṃ ca sa cottasthau pratāpavān .. 21 ..
2.19.d:
शिवस्तं दर्शनादेव जीवयामास लीलया ॥
ददौ बलमनन्तं च स चोत्तस्थौ प्रतापवान् ॥ 21 ॥

2.19.s:
śivaḥ svasainyaṃ devāṃśca prerayāmāsa satvaraḥ..
dānavendraiḥ sasainyaiśca yuddhārambho babhūva ha .. 22 ..
2.19.d:
शिवः स्वसैन्यं देवांश्च प्रेरयामास सत्वरः॥
दानवेन्द्रैः ससैन्यैश्च युद्धारम्भो बभूव ह ॥ 22 ॥

2.19.s:
svayaṃ mahendro yuyudhe sārddhaṃ ca vṛṣaparvaṇā ..
bhāskaro yuyudhe vipracittinā saha satvaraḥ .. 23 ..
2.19.d:
